skills.name: Uzumaki Naruto Combo
skills.description: Naruto's version of the Lion Combo. This skill deals 20 damage to one enemy. During 'Shadow Clones', this skill will deal 10 additional damage.

skills.name: Rasengan
skills.description: Naruto hits one enemy with a ball of chakra, dealing 45 damage to them and stunning their skills for 1 turn. This skill requires 'Shadow Clones'.

skills.name: Shadow Clones
skills.description: Naruto creates multiple shadow clones hiding his true self. Naruto gains 15 points of damage reduction for 5 turns. During this time, 'Uzumaki Naruto Combo' will deal an additional 10 damage and 'Rasengan' may be used.

skills.name: Sexy Technique
skills.description: This skill makes Uzumaki Naruto invulnerable for 1 turn. During 'Kyuubi's Chakra Awakening', this skill will be replaced by 'Kyuubi's Presence' and will be classed as Mental.

skills.name: Passive: Kyuubi's Chakra Awakening
skills.description: When Naruto reaches 50 health for the first time, Kyuubi's chakra will awaken, healing Naruto for 5 health every turn permanently. During this time, 'Shadow Clones' is improved and will grant 10 points of unpierceable damage reduction.

skills.name: KO Punch
skills.description: Sakura punches one enemy with all her strength, dealing 20 damage to them and stunning their physical and mental skills for 1 turn. During 'Inner Sakura', this skill will deal 10 additional damage.

skills.name: Cure
skills.description: Using basic healing techniques, Sakura heals herself or an ally for 20 health. During 'Inner Sakura', this skill will heal 10 additional health.

skills.name: Inner Sakura
skills.description: Sakura's inner self surfaces and urges her on. For 4 turns, Sakura will gain 10 points of damage reduction and will ignore non-damage effects. During this time, Sakura's skills will be improved.

skills.name: Sakura Replacement Technique
skills.description: This skill makes Haruno Sakura invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Lion Combo
skills.description: Copying a taijutsu combo that Lee used on him, Sasuke deals 30 damage to one enemy. This skill will deal an additional 15 damage to an enemy affected by 'Sharingan'.

skills.name: Chidori
skills.description: Using a lightning element attack jutsu, Sasuke deals 40 piercing damage to one enemy. This skill will deal an additional 15 damage to an enemy affected by 'Sharingan'. This skill requires 'Sharingan' to be active on Sasuke.

skills.name: Sharingan
skills.description: Sasuke targets one enemy. For 4 turns, Sasuke will gain 5 points of damage reduction and 'Chidori' may be used. During this time, that enemy will receive an additional 15 damage from 'Lion Combo' and 'Chidori'.

skills.name: Swift Block
skills.description: This skill makes Uchiha Sasuke invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Passive: Cursed Seal Awakening
skills.description: When Sasuke reaches 50 health for the first time, Cursed Seal will awaken, granting Sasuke 10 points of unpierceable damage reduction permanently. During this time, 'Sharingan' will also make the enemy unable to reduce damage or become invulnerable.

skills.name: Garouga
skills.description: Kiba deals 30 damage to one enemy. During 'Double Headed Wolf', this skill is improved and will cost 1 less random chakra.

skills.name: Double Headed Wolf
skills.description: Kiba and Akamaru turn into a giant beast and attack all enemies, dealing 15 damage to them for 3 turns. The following 3 turns, 'Garouga' is improved and will cost 1 less random chakra. During this time, Kiba gains 10 points of unpierceable damage reduction.

skills.name: Dynamic Air Marking
skills.description: Akamaru sprays urine on one enemy who cannot reduce damage or become invulnerable for 3 turns. During this time, 'Double Headed Wolf' and 'Garouga' will deal 10 additional damage to them. This skill may not be used on an enemy already affected by it.

skills.name: Smoke Bomb
skills.description: This skill makes Inuzuka Kiba invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Chakra Leach
skills.description: Shino directs his chakra draining bugs to one enemy, stealing 20 health and 1 taijutsu or genjutsu chakra from them.

skills.name: Female Bug
skills.description: Shino directs one of his female bugs to attach itself. For 3 turns, 'Chakra Leach' will steal 5 additional health from one enemy. During this time, if that enemy uses a new harmful skill, they will deal 5 less non-affliction damage for 1 turn. This skill cannot be used on an enemy already affected by it.

skills.name: Bug Wall
skills.description: Shino calls millions of bugs to create a wall protecting himself and his allies and granting them 25 points of permanent destructible defense.

skills.name: Bug Clone
skills.description: This skill makes Aburame Shino invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Hinata Gentle Fist
skills.description: Using the Hyuuga Clan's style of taijutsu, Hinata deals 15 damage to one enemy. During 'Byakugan', this skill will remove 1 taijutsu or ninjutsu chakra from them. Permanently, that enemy will receive 10 additional damage from Hinata's skills.

skills.name: Eight Trigrams 64 Palms Protection
skills.description: Hinata deals 10 piercing damage to all enemies for 2 turns, and all allies, including her, will gain 10 points of unpierceable damage reduction for 2 turns. During 'Byakugan', this skill will be improved and deal 5 additional damage.

skills.name: Byakugan
skills.description: Hinata activates her Byakugan and gains 5 points of damage reduction for 3 turns. The following 3 turns, 'Byakugan' will reveal any invisible skills used by the enemy team. While active, Hinata's skills will be improved. This skill cannot be countered and it ends if Hinata dies.

skills.name: Hinata Block
skills.description: This skill makes Hyuuga Hinata invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Meditate
skills.description: Shikamaru begins thinking up a strategy against one enemy, marking them for 5 turns. During this time, 'Shadow-Neck Bind' and 'Shadow Imitation' will last 1 additional turn on them. This skill cannot be countered or reflected and may not used on an enemy already affected by it.

skills.name: Shadow-Neck Bind
skills.description: Shikamaru chokes all enemies, making them unable to reduce damage and becoming invulnerable* while dealing 15 damage to them for 1 turn.

skills.name: Shadow Imitation
skills.description: Shikamaru captures all enemies in shadows, stunning their non-mental skills for 1 turn.

skills.name: Shikamaru Hide
skills.description: This skill makes Nara Shikamaru invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Partial Double Size
skills.description: Chouji doubles the size of his arms and attacks one enemy, dealing 20 damage to them.

skills.name: Meat Tank
skills.description: Chouji transforms into a meat tank, becoming invulnerable for 2 turns*. If targetable, one enemy will be dealt 10 damage for 2 turns.

skills.name: Akimichi Pills
skills.description: Chouji eats a pill, taking 15 affliction damage. 'Partial Double Size' will deal 20 additional damage and 'Meat Tank' will deal 10 additional damage permanently. Each use of this skill will deal 5 more affliction damage and will cost 2 additional random chakra. Chouji can only eat three pills.

skills.name: Effortless Block
skills.description: This skill makes Akimichi Chouji invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Passive: Butterfly Mode
skills.description: When Chouji eats the three pills, he will activate the Butterfly Mode, gaining 75% unpierceable damage reduction permanently and gaining 1 random chakra every turn.

skills.name: Mind Body Disturbance
skills.description: Using this skill Ino stuns one enemy's non-mental skills for 1 turn. During this time, that enemy will be unable to reduce damage or become invulnerable. One random different enemy will receive 20 damage that ignores invulnerability.

skills.name: Change of Heart
skills.description: Ino takes over the mind of an enemy. For 3 turns, that enemy will be stunned and cannot reduce damage or become invulnerable. The following 2 turns, this skill will be replaced by 'Art of the Valentine'.

skills.name: Chakra Hair Strand Trap
skills.description: Ino creates a trap for an enemy. For 1 turn, if that enemy uses a new harmful skill, then for 2 turns, 'Change of Heart' will last 1 additional turn on that enemy and 'Mind Body Disturbance' will make that enemy unable to reduce damage or become invulnerable for 2 turns instead. This skill is invisible.

skills.name: Ino Block
skills.description: This skill makes Yamanaka Ino invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Art of the Valentine
skills.description: Ino deals 25 damage to one enemy. If used on an enemy affected by 'Change of Heart', this skill will deal 30 damage instead.

skills.name: Twin Rising Dragons
skills.description: Tenten creates numerous weapons from her scroll, dealing 10 damage to all enemies for 2 turns. The following 2 turns, this skill can be used again to deal 20 damage to one enemy and 10 damage to all other enemies. This skill cannot be countered.

skills.name: Twin Rising Dragons Trap
skills.description: Tenten uses multiple projectiles on all enemies, dealing 15 piercing damage to them and an additional 5 damage for every time they were damaged by 'Twin Rising Dragons', removing all stacks afterwards. This skill cannot be countered.

skills.name: Twin Rising Dragons Full Release
skills.description: Tenten becomes invulnerable to non-mental skills for 1 turn and improves her skills for the next 3 times they are used. 'Twin Rising Dragons' will deal 5 additional damage, and 'Twin Rising Dragons Trap' will also stun all physical and chakra skills for 1 turn. This skill does not stack.

skills.name: Spiked Boulder Shield
skills.description: This skill makes Tenten invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Neji Gentle Fist
skills.description: Using the Hyuuga clan's special form of taijutsu, Neji deals 25 damage to one enemy for 2 turns. Each turn, their non-harmful skills will cost 1 additional random chakra. The following turn, 'Eight Trigram Sixty-Four Palms' will cost 1 taijutsu and 1 random chakra.

skills.name: Eight Trigram Heavenly Spin
skills.description: Neji becomes invulnerable for 1 turn while dealing 15 damage to all enemies. The following turn, 'Eight Trigram Sixty-Four Palms' will cost 1 bloodline and 1 random chakra.

skills.name: Eight Trigram Sixty-Four Palms
skills.description: Neji closes all of one enemy's chakra nodes, dealing 40 damage to them and removing 1 random chakra from them for 1 turn.

skills.name: Neji Byakugan
skills.description: This skill makes Hyuuga Neji invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: High Speed Taijutsu
skills.description: Lee deals 10 damage to one enemy for 3 turns. The following 3 turns, that enemy will receive 10 additional damage from 'Front Lotus' and Lee will gain 10 points of damage reduction.* This skill stacks and will deal 10 additional damage during 'Fifth Gate Opening'.

skills.name: Front Lotus
skills.description: Opening the first gate, Lee uses a high-powered taijutsu to deal 35 damage to one enemy. This skill will deal 15 additional damage during 'Fifth Gate Opening'.

skills.name: Fifth Gate Opening
skills.description: Lee removes all harmful effects from himself, and for 3 turns, he will be invulnerable to all harmful skills and this skill will be replaced by 'Final Lotus'. When he uses a new skill, he will receive 10 damage.* Lee cannot die from this skill.

skills.name: Lee Block
skills.description: This skill makes Rock Leeinvulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Final Lotus
skills.description: Lee uses his strongest ability, expending all his chakra and dealing 60 damage to one enemy, and an additional 15 damage for each time Lee received damage from 'Fifth Gate Opening'. Afterwards, 'Fifth Gate Opening' will end.

skills.name: Desert Graveyard
skills.description: Gaara crushes one enemy with sand, dealing 50 affliction damage to them and removing all 'Desert Coffin' stacks from them. This skill cannot be countered.

skills.name: Desert Coffin
skills.description: Gaara surrounds one enemy with a pile of sand, stunning their non-mental skills for 1 turn. Permanently, that enemy will receive 25 additional damage from 'Desert Graveyard'. This skill stacks.

skills.name: Third Eye
skills.description: For 2 turns, if a new harmful skill is used on Gaara or his allies, the following will happen: physical/chakra - skill costs reduced by 1 random chakra for 1 turn; affliction - heal 10 health and ignore affliction damage for 1 turn; mental - invulnerability for 1 turn. This skill ends after being triggered and is invisible.

skills.name: Sand Shield
skills.description: This skill makes Gaara of the Desert invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Black Secret Machine One Shot
skills.description: Kankuro uses two of his puppets to stab one enemy, dealing 30 piercing damage to them. During 'Puppet Preparation', this skill will deal an additional 5 damage.

skills.name: Poison Bomb
skills.description: One of Kankuro's puppets creates a cloud of smoke, dealing 10 affliction damage to all enemies. During 'Puppet Preparation', this skill will last 1 additional turn.

skills.name: Puppet Preparation
skills.description: Kankuro prepares his puppets for combat, gaining 10 points of destructible defense permanently. The following 3 turns, Kankuro's skills will be improved.

skills.name: Puppet Replacement Technique
skills.description: This skill makes Kankuro invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Cutting Whirlwind
skills.description: Temari creates a razor sharp wind, dealing 20 piercing damage to one enemy and 10 piercing damage to all others enemies. For 1 turn, Temari becomes invulnerable to non-mental skills.

skills.name: Summoning Quick Beheading Dance
skills.description: Temari summons the wind weasel Kamatari in the battlefield, dealing 35 damage to all enemies. If used one turn after 'Cutting Whirlwind', this skill will cost 1 less random chakra.

skills.name: Dust Wind
skills.description: Temari kicks up dust, making her team invulnerable for 1 turn. If targatable, all enemies will deal 20 less non-affliction damage for 1 turn. If used one turn after 'Cutting Whirlwind', this skill will decrease damage for 2 turns instead.

skills.name: Fan Defence Technique
skills.description: This skill makes Temari invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Illusion Bell Needles
skills.description: One enemy receives 15 damage. If used one turn after 'Needle and Bell Trap', that enemy will receive 15 additional damage. If used one turn after 'Unnerving Bells', that enemy will receive 25 additional damage.

skills.name: Needle and Bell Trap
skills.description: One enemy will be stunned for 1 turn. If used one turn after 'Illusion Bell Needles', that enemy will be unable to reduce damage or become invulnerbale for 2 turns.

skills.name: Unnerving Bells
skills.description: One enemy loses 1 random chakra. If used one turn after 'Illusion Bell Needles', that enemy will receive 5 additional non-affliction damage from melee skills permanently.

skills.name: Sharp Analysis
skills.description: This skill makes Tsuchi Kin invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Air Cutter
skills.description: Zaku fires a blast of supersonic air at one enemy, dealing 25 damage to them. The following turn, Zaku can use 'Extreme Air Cutter'.

skills.name: Wall of Air
skills.description: Zaku alters his air wave to protect one ally for 1 turn. The first harmful skill used on that ally will be countered. If successful, Zaku will instantly apply 'Air Cutter' on the countered enemy. This skill is invisible.

skills.name: Extreme Air Cutter
skills.description: Zaku boosts his air waves to a frightening level and deals 45 damage to all enemies. Afterwards, Zaku gains 1 random chakra.

skills.name: Airwave Deflection
skills.description: This skill makes Abumi Zaku invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Resonating Echo Drill
skills.description: Dosu attacks with his drill, dealing 20 damage to one enemy. For 1 turn, that enemy's physical and chakra skills will deal 15 less damage. If used after 'Sound Manipulation', this skill will deal an additional 10 damage.

skills.name: Sound Manipulation
skills.description: Dosu manipulates the sound to directly disorient one enemy, dealing 10 damage to them and stunning their skills for 1 turn.

skills.name: Melody Arm Tuning
skills.description: Dosu fine-tunes his Melody Arm to produce debilitating sound vibrations. The following 5 turns, 'Resonating Echo Drill' will deal 20 additional damage and 'Sound Manipulation' will deal 10 additional damage.

skills.name: Dosu Hide
skills.description: This skill makes Kinuta Dosu invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Water Needles
skills.description: Haku flings a number of water based needles, dealing 35 damage to one enemy. While improved, this skill will deal 45 damage to the target instead.

skills.name: Acupuncture
skills.description: Haku hits the acupuncture points of one enemy, stunning their skills for 1 turn. While improved, this skill will last 2 turns instead. This skill ignores invulnerability.

skills.name: Demonic Ice Mirrors
skills.description: Haku creates numerous mirrors, dealing 10 damage to all enemies for 3 turns. The following 3 turns, 'Water Needles' and 'Acupuncture' will be improved. During this time, Haku gains 30 points of destructible defense and ignores stun effects.

skills.name: Mirror Transfer
skills.description: This skill makes Haku invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: White Fang Slash
skills.description: Using his sword, Young Kakashi deals 20 piercing damage to one enemy. For 1 turn, that enemy will deal 5 less non-affliction damage. The following turn, Young Kakashi's skills will deal 10 additional damage.

skills.name: Amateur Raikiri
skills.description: Using a weaker form of his signature jutsu, Young Kakashi deals 25 piercing damage to one enemy. For 1 turn, that enemy will deal 5 less non-affliction damage. The following turn, Young Kakashi's skills will deal 10 additional damage.

skills.name: Implanted Sharingan
skills.description: For 1 turn, if one enemy uses a skill that removes or steals chakra, Kakashi will gain 1 random chakra; if they use a skill that stuns, Kakashi's skills will stun for 1 turn; if they use a skill that deals damage, Kakashi will deal 10 additional damage for 1 turn. This skill is invisible and ends when triggered.

skills.name: Sword Parry
skills.description: This skill makes Young Kakashi invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Piercing Stab
skills.description: Finding an opening in his enemy's defense, Obito quickly stabs them, dealing 15 damage to the enemy. During 'Obito Sharingan', this skill deals 25 piercing damage while ignoring invulnerability.

skills.name: Obito Goukakyuu no Jutsu
skills.description: Obito breathes searing fire on one enemy dealing 15 affliction damage to them for 2 turns. During 'Obito Sharigan', this skill will deal 30 affliction damage instantly while ignoring invulnerability.

skills.name: Obito Sharingan
skills.description: Obito activates his sharingan, gaining 15 points of damage reduction for 4 turns. During this time, if any of Obito's allies use a new skill, the cost of their harmful skills will be decreased by 1 random chakra for 1 turn. This skill cannot trigger twice in a row on the same ally. This skill ends if Obito dies.

skills.name: Sparkling Parry
skills.description: This skill makes Uchiha Obito invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Pit Trap
skills.description: Rin traps one enemy, dealing 20 piercing damage to them. For 1 turn, if that enemy uses a new skill, they will take another 10 piercing damage. This skill ignores invulnerability.

skills.name: Healing Touch
skills.description: Rin heals herself or an ally for 25 health and removes all harmful affliction skills from them.

skills.name: Medical Kit
skills.description: Rin gives her medical kit to herself or an ally, granting them 15 points of damage reduction and healing them 15 health for 3 turns.

skills.name: Flee
skills.description: This skill makes Nohara Rin invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Hanabi Gentle Fist
skills.description: Hanabi deals 20 damage to one enemy for 1 turn, and 10 damage the following turn. For 1 turn, if that enemy uses a new non-chakra skill, they will lose 1 non-genjutsu chakra.

skills.name: Hanabi Kaiten
skills.description: Hanabi spins at one enemy, dealing 20 damage to them for 1 turn, and 10 damage the following turn. For 1 turn, if that enemy uses a new non-physical skill, their skills will be stunned for 1 turn.

skills.name: Unyielding Tenacity
skills.description: Hanabi fights to the bitter end. For 2 turns, Hanabi will be unable to be killed and will ignore all stun effects. During this time, 'Hanabi Gentle Fist' and 'Hanabi Kaiten' will cost 1 random chakra and Hanabi will deal 5 additional damage.

skills.name: Byakugan Insight
skills.description: This skill makes Hyuuga Hanabi invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Chain Wrap
skills.description: Demon Brothers wrap one enemy in their chain. The following 3 turns, if Demon Brothers uses a new harmful skill on that enemy, their non-mental skills will be stunned for 1 turn. During this time, Demon Brothers becomes invulnerable to mental and affliction skills, and this skill is replaced by 'Chain Shred'.

skills.name: Bladed Gauntlet
skills.description: Demon Brothers uses their gauntlets shredding, gaining 10 permanent destructible defense and dealing 30 damage to one enemy. This skill will deal an additional 5 damage to the enemy affected by 'Chain Wrap'.

skills.name: Puddle Illusion
skills.description: The Demon Brothers hide in water, gaining 20 points of destructible defense and 1 taijutsu chakra.

skills.name: Demon Brothers Vanish
skills.description: This skill makes Demon Brothers invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Chain Shred
skills.description: Demon Brothers rip apart one enemy affected by 'Chain Wrap', dealing 45 piercing damage to them.

skills.name: Silent Homicide Technique
skills.description: Using an advanced assasination technique, Zabuza deals 30 piercing damage to one enemy. During 'Hidden Mist Technique', this skill will be improved and will deal 45 piercing damage to one enemy which ignores invulnerability.

skills.name: Great Waterfall Technique
skills.description: Zabuza knocks all enemies down with a giant wave of water, dealing 10 damage to them and stunning their physical and affliction skills for 1 turn.

skills.name: Hidden Mist Technique
skills.description: Zabuza creates a dense fog. For 2 turns, all enemies' physical and mental skills will cost 1 additional random chakra; This effect cannot be ignored. The following 2 turns, Zabuza gains 10 points of damage reduction and 'Silent Homicide Technique' will be improved. This skill ignores invulnerability.

skills.name: Water Clone Zabuza
skills.description: This skill makes Momochi Zabuza invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Underground Ambush
skills.description: Hiding in the ground, Oboro attacks one enemy from behind, dealing 20 damage and stunning their physical and mental skills for 1 turn. During 'Haze Clones', this skill is improved and targets all enemies instead.

skills.name: Exploding Kunai
skills.description: Oboro throws a kunai with an exploding tag on it dealing 15 damage to all enemies. During 'Haze Clones', this skill is improved and deals 20 damage.

skills.name: Haze Clones
skills.description: Oboro creates illusionary duplicates of himself. The following 3 turns, 'Exploding Kunai' and 'Underground Ambush' will be improved. During this time, Oboro gains 30 points of destructible defense and becomes invulnerable to mental skills.

skills.name: Fleet of Foot
skills.description: This skill makes Oboro invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Umbrella Toss
skills.description: Shigure tosses his umbrellas into the air, gaining 5 points of damage reduction for 3 turns. During this time, any enemy that uses a new skill on Shigure or his allies will be dealt 5 piercing damage; Triggers once per enemy a turn. The following 3 turns, 'Sprinkling Needles' may be used. This skill ends when Shigure dies.

skills.name: Sprinkling Needles
skills.description: Needles rain down from Shigure's umbrellas, dealing 10 piercing damage to all enemies for 3 turns. The following 2 turns, 'Needle Barrage' may be used on enemies affected by this skill. This skill cannot be countered and it requires 'Umbrella Toss' to be used.

skills.name: Needle Barrage
skills.description: Shigure specifically directs needles at one enemy, dealing 30 damage to them. This skill can only target enemies that are affected by 'Sprinkling Needles'.

skills.name: Umbrella Block
skills.description: This skill makes Shigure invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Five Elements Seal
skills.description: Shiore seals one enemy, dealing 10 affliction damage to them for 3 turns. During this time, that enemy will deal 10 less non-affliction damage and their harmful skills will cost 1 additional random chakra.

skills.name: Giant Snake Bind
skills.description: Shiore summons a giant snake and binds one enemy, dealing 20 damage to them for 2 turns. The first turn, that enemy will be stunned for 1 turn.

skills.name: Curse Seal
skills.description: Shiore places a curse seal on an enemy, stealing 5 health from them for 3 turns. While active, that enemy will be unable to become invulnerable*. During this time, if that enemy is killed, Shiore gains 1 random chakra*.

skills.name: Snake Body Replacement
skills.description: This skill makes Shiore Orochimaru invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Nirvana Fist Style
skills.description: Jiroubou deals 30 damage to one enemy. The following turn, 'Earth Seal Mud Cannonball' will deal 10 additional damage.

skills.name: Earth Seal Mud Cannonball
skills.description: Jiroubou deals 20 damage to all enemies. The following turn, 'Nirvana Fist Style' will deal 10 additional damage.

skills.name: Dungeon Chamber of Nothingness
skills.description: Jiroubou captures the enemy team in a prison of earth, stealing 2 random chakra from their pool. Jiroubou and all allies become invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Earth Wall Land Flip
skills.description: This skill makes Jiroubou invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Golden Arrow
skills.description: Kidoumaru fires a special arrow made of enzymes from his mouth at one enemy dealing 50 piercing damage.

skills.name: Summoning: Kyodaigumo
skills.description: Kidoumaru summons Kyodaigumo, dealing 10 damage to all enemies for 5 turns. The following 5 turns, Kidoumaru will gain 10 permanent destructible defense each turn and any new skill an enemy uses will have its cooldown increased by 1.

skills.name: Spider Web
skills.description: Kidoumaru uses spider web on himself or an ally. For 1 turn, the first enemy to use a new harmful damage skill on that ally will be countered, and will deal 15 less non-affliction damage for 2 turns. If successful, 'Spider Web' current cooldown will be increased by 1.

skills.name: Golden Armor
skills.description: This skill makes Kidoumaru invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Gattling Punch
skills.description: Using one body, Sakon and Ukon rapidly punch one enemy, dealing 40 damage to them.

skills.name: Parasite Demon Technique
skills.description: Sakon deals 15 affliction damage to one enemy permanently. During this time, Sakon gains 15 points of damage reduction and heals 5 health each turn. This skill cannot be used on the same target. This skill will end if used on a different enemy or if the affected enemy dies.

skills.name: Rest
skills.description: Ukon rests within the body of Sakon, healing him for 30 health. This skill will end 'Parasite Demon Technique' if it's currently active.

skills.name: Summoning: Rashoumon
skills.description: This skill makes Sakon  invulnerable  for 1 turn.

skills.name: Summoning: Doki
skills.description: Tayuya summons the Doki Demons. The Doki Demons will deal 15 piercing damage to all enemies for 2 turns. The following 2 turns, Tayuya will have 10 points of damage reduction. For 1 turn, 'Doki Ghosts' will be improved.

skills.name: Doki Ghosts
skills.description: The Doki Ghosts deal 15 affliction damage to one enemy. If used one turn after 'Summoning: Doki', this skill will also remove 1 random chakra. If used one turn after 'Demonic Flute Illusion', this skill will also fully stun for 1 turn.

skills.name: Demonic Flute Illusion
skills.description: Playing a genjutsu melody on her flute, Tayuya stuns the physical and chakra skills of all enemies for 1 turn. The following turn, 'Doki Ghosts' will be improved. This skill cannot be countered.

skills.name: Tayuya Insight
skills.description: This skill makes Tayuya invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Dance of the Camellia
skills.description: Kimimaro uses his superior taijutsu and arm bones as a sword dealing 30 damage to one enemy. This skill cannot be countered or reflected. Afterwards, Kimimaro will receive 5 affliction damage.*

skills.name: Dance of the Clematis
skills.description: Kimimaro attacks one enemy with an extremely hard and sharp bone spear, dealing 45 damage to them and stunning them for 1 turn. This skill cannot be countered or reflected. Afterwards, Kimimaro will receive 10 affliction damage.

skills.name: Dance of the Seedling Fern
skills.description: Kimimaro creates a forest of sharp bones, dealing 35 piercing damage to all enemies and making their physical and chakra skills deal 15 less damage. This skill cannot be countered or reflected. Afterwards, Kimimaro will receive 15 affliction damage for 2 turns.*

skills.name: Bone Defense
skills.description: This skill makes Kimimaro invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Kunai Assault
skills.description: Mizuki throws a number of kunai at one enemy, dealing 15 piercing damage to them for 2 turns.

skills.name: Execution Shuriken
skills.description: Mizuki throws one of his giant shurikens at one enemy, dealing 20 piercing damage to them, and an additional 10 damage for each 20 health they have lost. Mizuki only carries 2 of these giant shurikens at any time and can only use this skill twice in a game

skills.name: Genjutsu Ambush Tactics
skills.description: The following turn, Mizuki will become invulnerable, 'Execution Shuriken' will deal 30 additional damage and 'Kunai Assault' will deal 30 piercing damage instantly. This skill will end if Mizuki receives new harmful damage. This skill is invisible the first turn.

skills.name: Mizuki Dodge
skills.description: This skill makes Touji Mizuki invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Shuriken Throw
skills.description: Iruka throws a couple shurikens at one enemy who takes 20 piercing damage. This skill will deal an additional 10 damage for each 30 health Iruka has lost.

skills.name: Shield Ally
skills.description: Iruka uses his own body to shield one ally. For 1 turn, that ally will ignore all damage dealt to them. This skill is invisible.

skills.name: Sealed Bombs Square Formation
skills.description: Iruka creates a trap with a set of exploding seals. The following 2 turns, one enemy will take 75% more damage from melee skills. During this time, if that enemy use a new skill, they will take 20 piercing damage and this skill will end.

skills.name: Kunai Parry
skills.description: This skill makes Umino Iruka invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Chakra and Life Absorption
skills.description: Yoroi endows his attacks. The following 3 turns, 'Draining Assault' and 'Energy Drain' may be used.

skills.name: Energy Drain
skills.description: Yoroi touches one enemy, stealing 20 health from them for 1 turn and lowering their non-affliction damage by 5 until that enemy uses a new damage skill. During 'Draining Assault', this skill will steal 1 bloodline chakra. Requires 'Chakra and Life Absorption' to be used.

skills.name: Draining Assault
skills.description: Yoroi charges at one enemy with multiple energy drains, stealing 12 health from them for 3 turns and stealing 1 bloodline or ninjutsu chakra each turn. During this time, 'Energy Drain' will be improved. Requires 'Chakra and Life Absorption' to be used.

skills.name: Chakra Block
skills.description: This skill makes Akadou Yoroi invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Flexible Twisting Joints
skills.description: Using his distractingly loose joints, Misumi targets an ally or an enemy. If used on an enemy he will deal 15 damage that ignores invulnerability to them. If used on an ally, that ally will gain 15 points of damage reduction for 1 turn.

skills.name: Soft Physique Modification
skills.description: Misumi wraps around one enemy. For 2 turns all new harmful skills used on Misumi will be reflected to that enemy instead. During this time, that enemy will be unable to reduce damage or become invulnerable.

skills.name: Tighten Joints
skills.description: Misumi tightens his joints gaining 15 destructible defense. If 'Soft Physique Modification' is active, the enemy that it is active on will also receive 20 damage and will be stunned for 1 turn.

skills.name: Misumi Block
skills.description: This skill makes Tsurugi Misumi invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Dual Pin
skills.description: Anko deals 5 affliction damage to one enemy permanently. Until that enemy is killed, they will receive an additional 5 damage from all Anko's other skills. During this time, this skill will be replaced by 'Dragon Fire'.

skills.name: Twin Snakes
skills.description: Anko delivers a large dose of poison, dealing 15 affliction damage to one random enemy. For 1 turn, Anko becomes invulnerable to physical skills. The following turn, Anko's skills will cost 1 less random chakra.

skills.name: Hidden Shadow Snake Hand
skills.description: Anko calls forth snakes from under her jacket which slam into one enemy, dealing 20 damage and *15 affliction damage to them. Afterwards, Anko gains 5 permanent destructible defense.

skills.name: Quick Reflexes
skills.description: This skill makes Mitarashi Anko invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Dragon Fire
skills.description: Anko scorches the battlefield with fire, dealing 10 affliction damage to one enemy and 5 affliction damage to all others for 2 turns. During this time, they will also receive an additional 5 affliction damage from all other affliction skills. This skill ends when Anko dies.

skills.name: Prepared Needle Shot
skills.description: Shizune shoots hidden needles at one enemy dealing 15 damage to them.

skills.name: Poison Mist
skills.description: Shizune breaths a poison cloud on one enemy who takes 10 affliction damage for 3 turns. During this time, if that enemy uses a new harmful skill, they will receive 10 additional damage from non-affliction skills for 1 turn.

skills.name: Healing Resuscitation Regeneration
skills.description: Using this advanced healing technique, Shizune heals one ally for 35 health and removes all enemy affliction skills from them.

skills.name: Shizune Dodge
skills.description: This skill makes Shizune invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Mystical Palm Technique
skills.description: Kabuto custs one enemy through their flesh like a scalpel, dealing 20 piercing damage to them. For 1 turn, that enemy's harmful skills will cost 1 additional random chakra, and they will receive 10 additional damage from melee skills. This additional damage effect may only trigger once per turn.

skills.name: Temple of Nirvana
skills.description: Kabuto creates a large scale genjutsu. For 1 turn, any enemy that uses a new skill will have their physical and chakra skills stunned and will receive 10 additional damage from melee skills for 1 turn. This skill is invisible.

skills.name: Secret Healing Wound Destruction
skills.description: Kabuto removes all enemy affliction skills from himself, gains 20 points of damage reduction for 1 turn and heals 35 health. This skill will heal 5 less health each time it is used.

skills.name: Dead Soul Technique
skills.description: This skill makes Yakushi Kabuto invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Raikiri
skills.description: An attack so strong it is said to cut lightning. This skill deals 35 piercing damage to one enemy. This skill cannot be countered or reflected.

skills.name: Summoning: Ninja Dogs
skills.description: Kakashi summons ninja dogs which bite an enemy. That enemy will have their non-mental skills stunned for 1 turn. For 1 turn, that enemy will be receive 5 additional damage from chakra skills.

skills.name: Kakashi Sharingan
skills.description: Kakashi activates his copying sharingan. For 5 turns, Kakashi will every turn imitate a jutsu from a random enemy, copying a random harmful skill from that enemy, while changing the cost of the copied skill to random chakras.

skills.name: Clever Hiding
skills.description: This skill makes Hatake Kakashi invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Cherry Blossom Suffocation
skills.description: Kurenai suffocates all enemies with illusionary cherry blossoms, dealing 10 damage to them for 3 turns. During this time, if 'Plant-Form Attack' is used on an enemy affected by this skill, they will have their physical and chakra skills stunned for 1 turn.

skills.name: Plant Form Attack
skills.description: Kurenai hinders an enemy with her genjutsu, making them unable to reduce damage or become invulnerable while dealing 20 damage to them for 1 turn. If that enemy is affected by 'Cherry Blossom Suffocation', they will have their physical and chakra skills stunned for 1 turn.

skills.name: Demonic Illusion: Tree Binding Death
skills.description: For 1 turn, the first physical or chakra skill used on herself, or an ally, will be countered. If successful, then for 2 turns, the countered enemy will have their physical and chakra skills stunned and will receive double damage from mental skills.

skills.name: Vanishing Illusion
skills.description: This skill makes Yuhi Kurenai invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Flying Swallow
skills.description: Using blades with wind chakra, Asuma and his allies gain 10 points of damage reduction and all enemies take 10 damage for 3 turns. *While active, each turn this skill will increase its damage and points of damage redution by 5.

skills.name: Finishing Blow
skills.description: Asuma deals 35 damage to one enemy. During the second turn of 'Flying Swallow', this skill will fully stun for 1 turn. During the third turn of 'Flying Swallow', this skill will deal 5 additional damage and will remove 1 random chakra.

skills.name: Self Sacrifice
skills.description: Sarutobi Asuma protects one ally from harm. For 1 turn, that ally will become invulnerable to harmful skills.

skills.name: Wind Chakra Blades Block
skills.description: This skill makes Sarutobi Asuma invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Strong Whirlwind
skills.description: Gai kicks with a strong whirlwind, dealing 35 damage to one enemy. During 'Sixth Gate Opening', this skill is improved and deals 65 piercing damage that ignores invulnerability.

skills.name: Sixth Gate Opening
skills.description: Gai opens six chakra gates, taking 40% of his current health as affliction damage * and becoming invulnerable for 2 turns. The following 2 turns, 'Strong Whirlwind' will deal 65 piercing damage that  ignores invulnerability.

skills.name: Counter Punch
skills.description: Gai singles out one enemy to counter attack. If that enemy uses a new harmful skill, they will be countered and will receive 30 damage. This skill is invisible.

skills.name: Gai Dodge
skills.description: This skill makes Maito Gai invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Flying Thunder God
skills.description: Using his teleportation abilities, Minato either attacks one enemy, dealing 20 damage to them or defends an ally making them invulnerable for 1 turn. Minato will also become invulnerable for 1 turn. The following 3 turns, this skill will cost 1 additional random chakra and will deal 15 additional damage.

skills.name: Space-Time Marking
skills.description: Minato marks an enemy, making them unable to reduce damage or become invulnerable for 2 turns. If 'Flying Thunder God' is used, that enemy will receive 10 additional damage and their mark will be extended by 1 turn. This skill ignores invulnerability.

skills.name: Space-Time Kunai Scatter
skills.description: By scattering hiraishin kunais, Minato applies 'Space-Time Marking' on all enemies. For 2 turns, Minato gains 1 random chakra.This skill is invisible ignores invulnerability.

skills.name: Seal Sensing
skills.description: This skill makes Namikaze Minato invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Four Symbols Seal
skills.description: Kushina attempts to seal an enemy away, destroying their destructible defense, dealing 15 piercing damage to them, stunning their skills for 1 turn, removing 1 random chakra from them and permanently lowering the non-affliction damage they deal and receive by 5.

skills.name: Life Link
skills.description: For 4 turns if either Kushina or one enemy dies, the other will die as well. The following 4 turns, this skill will be replaced by 'Life Transfer'. This skill ignores invulnerability and cannot be countered, reflected, ignored, removed or interact with other skills.

skills.name: Adamantine Sealing Chains
skills.description: Kushina uses an immensely powerful seal, surrounding one enemy with chains, first removing all helpful skills on them and then stunning them and making them invulnerable to all further skills for 2 turns. This skill ignores invulnerability and cannot be countered or reflected.

skills.name: Adamantine Covering Chains
skills.description: This skill makes Uzumaki Kushina invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Life Transfer
skills.description: Kushina heals an ally for 25 points and deals 25 damage to herself.

skills.name: Crescent Moon Slash
skills.description: Hayate jumps on an enemy from above, dealing 20 piercing damage to them. Permanently, 'Dance of the Crescent Moon' will deal 10 additional damage when this skill is used. This skill stacks.

skills.name: Dance of the Crescent Moon
skills.description: Using both his sword and genjutsu, Hayate becomes invulnerable for 1 turn and deals 30 damage to one enemy.

skills.name: Eavesdrop
skills.description: For 1 turn, the first harmful skill used on Hayate will be countered. This skill is invisible the first turn. If successful, 'Dance of the Crescent Moon' will permanently deal 10 additional damage when this skill is used. This skill stacks.

skills.name: Determined Retreat
skills.description: This skill makes Gekko Hayate invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Sudden Strike
skills.description: A simple, blindingly fast attack leaving an illusionary trail to throw off enemies. Baki does 20 piercing damage to one enemy. If that enemy's health drops to 5 or less, they will be instantly killed.

skills.name: Wind Blade
skills.description: Baki conjures a maelstrom of blade-like wind and does 40 piercing damage to one enemy. If that enemy's health drops to 10 or less, they will be instantly killed.

skills.name: Flak Jacket
skills.description: Baki puts on a specialized flak jacket from the sand village on himself, or one ally granting that character 50 destructible defense for 4 turns. During this time, that character will ignore all harmful effects except damage until this defense is destroyed.

skills.name: Baki Teleportation
skills.description: This skill makes Baki invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Kusanagi
skills.description: Orochimaru pulls the legendary sword Kusanagi and stabs one enemy, dealing 30 damage to them and removing 1 bloodline or genjutsu chakra from that enemy.

skills.name: Cursed Seal Technique
skills.description: Orochimaru places a cursed seal on an ally or an enemy, dealing 15 affliction damage to them and granting them 1 random chakra. This skill ignores invulnerability.

skills.name: Major Summoning: Manda
skills.description: By summoning Manda in the battlefield, Orochimaru deals 45 damage to one enemy. For the rest of the game, Orochimaru will gain 1 random chakra and this skill will be replaced 'Constrict and Bite'.

skills.name: Earth Clone Technique
skills.description: This skill makes Orochimaru invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Constrict and Bite
skills.description: Manda wraps around an enemy, stunning them for 1 turn. The following turn, Manda will eat them, dealing 30 damage to them.

skills.name: Great Fireball Technique
skills.description: Jiraiya spits a giant fireball at all enemies, dealing 20 affliction damage to one enemy and 10 affliction damage to all other enemies.

skills.name: Summoning: Toad Mouth Bind
skills.description: Jiraiya summons the stomach of a giant toad, placing all characters within it. For 2 turns, enemies will be unable to reduce damage or become invulnerable and during this time if Jiraiya or one of his allies is damaged with a new non-affliction skill, they will become invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Major Summoning: Gamabunta
skills.description: Jiraiya summons Gamabunta in the battlefield, dealing 25 affliction damage to all enemies. For the rest of the game, the enemy team will receive an additional 5 damage from affliction skills and this skill will be replaced by 'Toad Oil Flame Bullet'.

skills.name: Spiked Buddha
skills.description: This skill makes Jiraiya invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Toad Oil Flame Bullet
skills.description: Gamabunta spits even more oil at the enemy team, followed by Jiraiya spitting fire at them, dealing 15 affliction damage to all enemies for 2 turns.

skills.name: Painful Sky Leg
skills.description: Tsunade performs a drop kick with her insane strength, dealing 35 damage to one enemy and stunning their skills for 1 turn.

skills.name: Revitalizing Heal
skills.description: If used on an ally: That ally will heal 30 health for 1 turn. If used on Tsunade: She will apply 'Creation Rebirth' on herself instead, removing all affliction skills from her, healing 35 health and becoming immune to affliction damage for 1 turn.

skills.name: Major Summoning: Katsuyu
skills.description: Tsunade summons the slug queen Katsuyu, healing her team for 20 health instantly. Katsuyu also spits acid on all enemies, dealing 20 affliction damage to them. For the rest of the game, Tsunade and her allies will heal 5 health and this skill will be replaced by 'Tongue Tooth Sticky Acid'.

skills.name: Elbow Block
skills.description: This skill makes Tsunade invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Creation Rebirth
skills.description: Tsunade uses her stored chakra to remove all harmful affliction skills from herself, heal 35 health, and become immune to affliction damage for 1 turn. This skill is automatically activated when 'Revitalizing Heal' is used on Tsunade.

skills.name: Tongue Tooth Sticky Acid
skills.description: Katsuyu releases an acidic paste from the mouth, dealing 15 affliction damage to all enemies and healing 15 health for Tsunade and her allies.

skills.name: Fire Dragon Flame Missile
skills.description: Sandaime Hokage deals 30 affliction damage to one enemy. This enemy also takes 10 affliction damage the following turn.

skills.name: Dead Demon Consuming Seal
skills.description: The death god sucks the life out of one enemy who takes 40 affliction damage, is stunned and cannot reduce damage or become invulnerable every turn.* Sandaime himself takes 20 affliction damage and is stunned every turn. This skill cannot be removed or ignored and ends when Sandaime dies.

skills.name: Summoning: Enma
skills.description: By summoning Enma, Sandaime and all allies will gain 15 points of damage reduction and they cannot be killed for 2 turns. If targetable, Sandaime will also deal 15 damage to all enemies for 2 turns.

skills.name: Earth Release Wall
skills.description: This skill makes Sandaime Hokage invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Tree Strangulation
skills.description: Hashirama catches and crushes one enemy in giant tree branches, dealing 25 piercing damage to that enemy and stunning their physical and chakra skills for 1 turn. During 'Birth of the Trees', this skill will cost 1 less random chakra.

skills.name: Branch Manipulation
skills.description: Hashirama sends out his trees in all directions, dealing 10 affliction damage to all enemies and granting 5 points of permanent destructible defense to himself and his allies. During 'Birth of the Trees', this skill will have no cooldown.

skills.name: Birth of the Trees
skills.description: Hashirama summons a giant field of trees. For 3 turns, any enemy that uses a new harmful skill will have the cost of their harmful skills increased by 2 random chakra for 1 turn. For 3 turns, Hashirama and his allies are granted 10 points of destructible defense.

skills.name: Deflection
skills.description: This skill makes Shodai Hokage invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Water Assault
skills.description: Tobirama encases one enemy in water, making them ignore all helpful effects for 1 turn and dealing 15 damage to them.

skills.name: Water Collision Destruction
skills.description: Summoning a giant wave of water, Tobirama deals 10 damage to all enemies for 3 turns. Each turn, all enemies will have all their affliction skills stunned. The following 3 turns, 'Water Assault' will deal 15 additional damage.

skills.name: Bringer of Darkness
skills.description: Tobirama plunges the battlefield into total darkness. For 1 turn, Tobirama and his allies will become invulnerable to physical and mental skills.

skills.name: Water Encampment Wall
skills.description: This skill makes Nidaime Hokage invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Hiraishin Rasengan
skills.description: Yondaime deals 40 damage to one enemy, which ignores invulnerability and cannot be countered or reflected. The following turn, this skill will cost 1 ninjutsu chakra and will deal 35 damage instead.

skills.name: Space Time Barrier
skills.description: Using his space-time abilities, Yondaime Hokage targets one ally or himself. For 1 turn, all new non-mental skills used on that ally will be reflected onto the enemy. This skill is invisible.

skills.name: Partial Dead Demon Consuming Seal
skills.description: Yondaime seals part of one enemy away, dealing 25 affliction damage to them and stunning their physical and chakra skills for 1 turn. If that enemy's health drops to 10 or lower, they will be instantly killed. Yondaime will also receive 15 affliction damage.

skills.name: Kunai Defense
skills.description: This skill makes Yondaime Hokage invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Sand Mastery
skills.description: Using sand to both defend and attack, Gaara gains 5 permanent destructible defense. Permanently, Gaara's skills will cost 1 less random chakra.

skills.name: Desert Imperial Funeral
skills.description: Gaara deals 25 piercing damage to one enemy. For 1 turn, that enemy will be unable to reduce damage or become invulnerable and their skills will cost 1 additional random chakra. If that enemy is affected by 'Quicksand Waterfall', their skills will cost 2 additional random chakra instead.

skills.name: Quicksand Waterfall
skills.description: Gaara creates massive waves of sand. For 4 turns, Gaara and his allies gain 10 destructible defense and all enemies take 10 damage*. During this time, if Gaara or an ally receives new non-affliction damage, they will gain 5 destructible defense the following turn.

skills.name: Shield of Shukaku
skills.description: Gaara uses the ultimately hard absolute defense, creating a protective shield in front of his team and granting them 20 points of destructible defense for 3 turns.

skills.name: Unpredictable Assault
skills.description: Using his drunken master abilities, Lee deals 20 damage to one enemy that cannot be countered. For 1 turn, if that enemy uses a new harmful skill, Lee will instantly heal 10 health. Permanently, Lee will deal 5 additional damage. This effect stacks.

skills.name: Drunken Fist
skills.description: Lee charges at an enemy and hits them with a knockout blow, dealing 30 damage to that enemy, and for 1 turn, their skills will deal 100% less damage.

skills.name: Drunken Counter
skills.description: Lee targets himself or an ally. For 1 turn, the first harmful physical skill used on that ally will be countered. If successful, the countered enemy will have 'Unpredictable Assault' used on them. This skill is invisible.

skills.name: Drunken Leap
skills.description: This skill makes Drunken Lee invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Curse Seal: Tiger
skills.description: By drinking a curse seal potion, Mizuki transforms into a wild tiger. The following 3 turns, Mizuki will gain 35 points of destructible defense and during this time, 'Curse Seal: Tiger Punch' will be >improved< and 'Puppets Genjutsu' will be replaced by its alternate version.

skills.name: Curse Seal: Tiger Punch
skills.description: Mizuki fiercely punches one enemy, dealing 30 damage to them. For 2 turns, that enemy's skills will deal 15 less non-affliction damage. During 'Curse Seal: Tiger', this skill is improved and will deal 45 damage instead. This skill does not stack.

skills.name: Puppets Genjutsu
skills.description: Mizuki puts an enemy under a genjutsu. For 2 turns, that enemy will be unable to reduce damage or become invulnerable, and their skills will deal 5 less damage and will cost 1 additional random chakra. During this time, if that enemy does not use a new skill, they will take 10 damage.

skills.name: Evil Intentions
skills.description: This skill makes Cursed Seal Mizuki invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Curse Seal: Tiger Bomb
skills.description: Mizuki charges like a bomb, dealing 45 damage to one enemy and becoming invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Kyuubi Rasengan
skills.description: Kyuubi Naruto deals 40 damage to one enemy and stuns their physical and chakra skills for 1 turn. Kyuubi Naruto takes 10 affliction damage*. During 'Kyuubi Rage', this skill will deal 50 damage. During 'Kyuubi Chakra', this skill will deal 30 damage.

skills.name: Kyuubi Rage
skills.description: Using the vile Kyuubi chakra surrounding him, Kyuubi Naruto deals 10 damage to all enemies for 3 turns. During this time, 'Kyuubi Rasengan' will be improved*. This skill will cancel 'Kyuubi Chakra' when used.

skills.name: Kyuubi Chakra
skills.description: Unknowingly using the Kyuubi Chakra, Naruto gains 10 points of damage reduction* and heals 15 health each turn for 3 turns. During this time, 'Kyuubi Rasengan' will be worsened.* This skill will cancel 'Kyuubi Rage' when used.

skills.name: Chakra Howl
skills.description: This skill makes Kyuubi Naruto invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Corrupt Chidori
skills.description: Using a cursed seal chakra corrupted Chidori Sasuke does 45 piercing damage to one enemy and for 2 turns, will reduce their non-affliction damage by 20.

skills.name: Katon: Goukakyuu no Jutsu
skills.description: Sasuke launches a giant fireball, dealing 20 affliction damage to one enemy. For 1 turn, If that enemy uses a skill they will take 10 affliction damage. During 'Cursed Seal', this skill will be improved and will also deal an additional 10 damage.

skills.name: Cursed Seal
skills.description: Sasuke taps into the power of cursed seal, becoming invulnerable for 1 turn and taking 20 affliction damage, which cannot kill him. The following turn, 'Corrupt Chidori' will cost 1 random chakra, 'Katon: Goukakyuu no Jutsu' will have no cost, and this skill will be replaced by 'Dark Void'.

skills.name: Sharingan Evasion
skills.description: This skill makes Cursed Seal Sasuke invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Dark Void
skills.description: Expunging the corrupt chakra, Sasuke engulfs one enemy, stunning them for 2 turns, and making them invulnerable to all skills. When this skill ends, that enemy will receive 55 damage. This skill will end if Sasuke dies.

skills.name: Sand Claw
skills.description: Gaara attacks with a claw of concentrated sand, dealing 35 damage to one enemy and gaining 5 points of destructible defense.

skills.name: Constricting Sand Prison
skills.description: Gaara traps an enemy with sand, dealing 10 damage to them each turn. During this time, the first skill that enemy uses will be countered and this skill will end.

skills.name: Sand Transformation
skills.description: Each turn, for 3 turns, Gaara will gain 15 destructible defense. When this skill ends, Gaara will transform into the Shukaku for 3 turns, reducing the cost of 'Sand Claw' by 1 random and replacing 'Constricting Sand Prison' and 'Sand Transformation'.

skills.name: Thick Sand Coat
skills.description: This skill makes Shukaku Gaara invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Drilling Air Bullet
skills.description: Sending forth a powerful ball of wind, Gaara deals 45 piercing damage to one enemy.

skills.name: True Awakening
skills.description: Gaara truly lets Shukaku awaken from inside him, letting it take over. The Following turn, 'Sand Claw' and 'Drilling Air Bullet' will deal double damage and this skill will have no cost.

skills.name: Samehada Slash
skills.description: Using his sword, Samehada, Kisame slashes one enemy who takes 20 damage and stunning their physical and chakra skills for 1 turn.

skills.name: Samehada Shred
skills.description: Kisame unwraps Samehada and shreds one enemy. For 2 turns, that enemy takes 20 damage and 1 random chakra is stolen from their pool.

skills.name: Water Shark Projectile
skills.description: Using a stream of compressed water, Kisame deals 20 damage to one enemy and stuns their chakra and affliction skills for 1 turn.

skills.name: Samehada Scale Block
skills.description: This skill makes Hoshigaki Kisame invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Mangekyo Sharingan
skills.description: Itachi becomes invulnerable, enhancing 'Amaterasu' and 'Tsukuyomi', increasing their cooldowns by 2, and doubling their costs. During this time, Itachi will receive 15 affliction damage a turn, which cannot be ignored, and will ignore healing effects. This skill can be used again for free to cancel it.

skills.name: Amaterasu
skills.description: Itachi burns one enemy with his flames, dealing 15 affliction damage to them and, each following turn, they will receive 10 affliction damage a turn. This skill does not stack. During 'Mangekyou Sharingan', this skill will deal 30 initial affliction damage and target all enemies. Ends if Itachi dies.

skills.name: Tsukuyomi
skills.description: Itachi mentally tortures one enemy for 3 days and nights in a matter of seconds, dealing 20 damage to them and stunning them for 1 turn. If used during 'Mangekyou Sharingan', this skill will last 3 turns.

skills.name: Sharingan Insight
skills.description: This skill makes Uchiha Itachi invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Oodama Rasengan
skills.description: Naruto uses a greater version of Rasengan, dealing 40 piercing damage to one enemy, ignoring invulnerability. During 'Kyuubi Boost', this skill will stun their non-mental skills for 1 turn. Afterwards, Naruto takes 5 affliction damage*. During 'Passive: Three Tails Release', this skill will be replaced.

skills.name: Shadow Clones: Rasengan
skills.description: The following turn, Naruto will deal 20 piercing damage to one enemy. During this time, Naruto will ignore all harmful effects. During 'Passive: Three Tails Release', this skill will be replaced. The target of this skill is invisible.

skills.name: Kyuubi Boost
skills.description: Naruto loses 10 health* and gains 1 ninjutsu chakra. For 3 turns, he will have 10 points of damage reduction. The following 3 turns, he will ignore stun effects and this skill will be replaced by 'Kyuubi Empowered Rasengan'. Cannot be used during 'Passive: Three Tails Transformation'.

skills.name: Shadow Clone Save
skills.description: This skill makes Uzumaki Naruto (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Kyuubi Empowered Rasengan
skills.description: Naruto uses a Rasengan empowered by the Kyuubi chakra, dealing 25 damage to one enemy and stunning their non-mental skills for 1 turn.

skills.name: Passive: Three Tails Release
skills.description: Each time Naruto uses 'Oodama Rasengan' or 'Kyuubi Empowered Rasengan', he will gain 1 Kyuubi Rage stack. At 4 Kyuubi Rage stacks, Kyuubi chakra will be released for 3 turns, removing all harmful skills, granting 50% unpierceable damage reduction, ignoring stun effects, and improving his skills.

skills.name: Three-Tail: Claw Smash
skills.description: Naruto dashes forward and strikes one enemy with a powerful smash, dealing 40 piercing damage and stunning their non-mental skills for 1 turn. Afterwards, Naruto takes 5 affliction damage. This skill ignores invulnerability.

skills.name: Three-Tail: Chakra Shockwave
skills.description: The following turn, Naruto will deal 20 affliction damage to all enemies. During this time, Naruto will ignore all harmful effects. This skill is invisible.

skills.name: Chakra Enhanced Punch
skills.description: Enhancing her attack with finely controlled chakra, Sakura destroys the destructible defense of one enemy and deals 25 piercing damage to them. This skill will be replaced by 'Blossom's Fury'.

skills.name: Trained Healing
skills.description: Using her trained healing skills, Sakura heals an ally for 20 health for 2 turns. Each turn, that ally will have all affliction skills removed from them.

skills.name: Self Heal
skills.description: Sakura targets herself permanently, healing 20 health instantly the first time she is damaged by a skill. This skill is invisible and ends when triggered.

skills.name: Insightful Dodge
skills.description: This skill makes Haruno Sakura (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Blossom's Fury
skills.description: Sakura releases a ground breaking punch, destroying the destructible defense of all enemies and dealing 35 piercing damage to one enemy and 20 piercing damage to all others. This skill cannot be reflected and returns to 'Chakra Enhanced Punch' once it's used.

skills.name: Great Beast Painting: Lions
skills.description: Sai creates a number of ink lions to attack one enemy dealing 30 damage to them, and for 1 turn, Sai will gain 15 points of destructible defense.

skills.name: Great Beast Painting: Snake
skills.description: Sai creates a snake made of ink to trap one enemy. stunning their physical and chakra skills for 1 turn. During this time, that enemy will be unable to reduce damage or become invulnerable. This skill ignores invulnerability.

skills.name: Adaptive Painting
skills.description: For 3 turns, any ally that is stunned will become invulnerable for 1 turn; Any ally that has chakra removed/stolen will gain 1 random ; For each enemy non-affliction skill that damages Sai or his allies will increase Sai's damage by 10 for 1 turn. The following 3 turns, 'Great Beast Painting: Snake' will be replaced.

skills.name: Ink Clone
skills.description: This skill makes Sai (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Great Beast Painting: Bird
skills.description: Sai creates a giant ink bird that crashes into one enemy, dealing 25 damage to them and stunning their physical and chakra skills for 1 turn.

skills.name: Man Beast Clone
skills.description: Kiba grant himself and one ally 5 damage reduction. If Kiba use a new harmful skill, that ally gains 10 destructible defense for 1 turn. If that ally uses a  new harmful skill , Kiba gains 5 additional damage for 1 turn; Doesn't stack. Becomes 'Enhanced Garouga', cannot be removed.

skills.name: Piercing Fang
skills.description: Kiba deals 20 piercing damage to one enemy. For 1 turn, Kiba will ignore stun effects and his other skills will cost 1 random chakra less.

skills.name: Fang Over Fang
skills.description: Kiba deals 20 damage to all enemies this turn. For 2 turns, Kiba will deal 5 more damage on them.

skills.name: Hide in the Shade
skills.description: This skill makes Inuzuka Kiba (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Enhanced Garouga
skills.description: Kiba deals 30 piercing damage to one enemy and stuns all other enemies Harmful for 1 turn.

skills.name: Insect Swarm
skills.description: Shino sends out wave of his insect army at one enemy, dealing 15 affliction damage to them for 3 turns. The following 3 turns, that enemy will be invulnerable to all friendly skills each turn and during this time this skill will be replaced by 'Insect Consumption'.

skills.name: Insect Barricade
skills.description: The following turn, the first new harmful skill used on himself or one ally will be countered, 'Parasitic Giant Beetle Infestation' will be placed on the countered enemy and then activated. If this skill does not counter an enemy, Shino will gain 1 Bloodline chakra. This skill is invisible.

skills.name: Parasitic Giant Beetle Infestation
skills.description: Shino infects one enemy with a small bug. 3 turns after this skill has been used, the bug bursts out, dealing 30 affliction damage to them and activating all other copies of this skill on that enemy. This skill is invisible.

skills.name: Insect Cocoon
skills.description: This skill makes Aburame Shino (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Insect Consumption
skills.description: Shino commands his insects to drain the chakra of one enemy affected by 'Insect Swarm' stealing 1 random chakra from them and increasing the damage that enemy receives from 'Insect Swarm' by 5 that turn.

skills.name: Gentle Step Twin Lions Fist
skills.description: Hinata creates two chakra lions and attacks an enemy, dealing 30 piercing damage to them and removing 1 taijutsu or ninjutsu chakra from them. The following turn, 'Pressure Point Closure' will stun for 1 turn.

skills.name: Eight Trigrams Thirty Two Palms
skills.description: Hinata uses a lesser form of eight trigram sixty four palms, dealing 30 piercing damage to one enemy and stunning their non-mental skills for 1 turn. The following turn, 'Pressure Point Closure' will remove 1 taijutsu or ninjutsu chakra.

skills.name: Pressure Point Closure
skills.description: Hinata closes an enemy's pressure point, dealing 20 damage to them.

skills.name: Byakugan Sight
skills.description: This skill makes Hyuuga Hinata (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Shadow Sewing
skills.description: Shikamaru sends several tendrils of shadow to one enemy, dealing 35 damage to them and stunning their non-mental skills for 1 turn. Afterwards, this skill will be replaced by 'Shadow Sewing - Hold' for 1 turn.

skills.name: Long-Range Tactics
skills.description: Shikamaru goes long. For 4 turns, each time Shikamaru uses a new harmful skill, he will become invulnerable for 1 turn. If Shikamaru receives new non-affliction damage, this skill will be ignored for 1 turn. The following 4 turns, this skill will be replaced by 'Final Explosion'.

skills.name: Expert Analysis
skills.description: By carefully analyzing one enemy, Shikamaru figures out their weakness. For 3 turns, any time that enemy uses a new skill that enemy will be unable to become invulnerable or reduce damage and all helpful counter and reflect effects on them will be ignored for 1 turn. This skill is invisible

skills.name: Panicked Dodge
skills.description: This skill makes Nara Shikamaru (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Shadow Sewing - Hold
skills.description: Shikamaru continues to maintain his technique, stunning the non-mental skills of the enemy affected by 'Shadow Sewing' or this skill for 1 turn and dealing 20 damage to them. After that, this skill remains active on the enemy.

skills.name: Final Explosion
skills.description: Using his shadow technique, his analysis and his range, Shikamaru traps one enemy in a pit, and blows them up. One enemy affected by 'Shadow Sewing' or 'Shadow Sewing - Hold' and 'Expert Analysis' while Shikamaru is invulnerable through 'Long-Range Tactics' will receive 100 damage.

skills.name: Mega Palm Thrusts
skills.description: Expanding his arms for more inertia, Chouji deals 30 damage to one enemy and increase the cost of their harmful skills by 1 random chakra for 1 turn.

skills.name: Spiked Meat Tank
skills.description: If used on an enemy: That enemy will be dealt 25 damage and Chouji becomes invulnerable for 1 turn. If used on himself or an ally: For 1 turn, all non-mental skills used on that ally will be countered and any countered enemy will be dealt 10 piercing damage*. This counter is Invisible and has a cooldown of 2.

skills.name: Expansion Technique
skills.description: Chouji grows gigantic, gaining 45 destructible defense for 3 turns. The following 3 turns, 'Mega Palm Thrusts' will target all enemies and 'Spiked Meat Tank' will target all enemies or will target all allies if used on an ally.

skills.name: Chouji Leap
skills.description: This skill makes Akimichi Chouji (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Mind Body Switch
skills.description: Ino forces her mind into one enemy, dealing 25 piercing damage to them and ending any delayed skill that enemy currently has. Afterwards, that enemy will be stunned for 1 turn.

skills.name: Proxy Surveillance
skills.description: Ino predicts one enemy's move. For 1 turn, if this character uses a new harmful skill, it will be delayed by 2 turns. This skill is invisible.

skills.name: Rudimentary Healing
skills.description: Using her healing skills, Ino heals an ally for 20 health. If Ino has used any of her other skills on the previous turn, this skill will heal 10 additional health instead.

skills.name: Hide
skills.description: This skill makes Yamanaka Ino (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Weapon Upgrade
skills.description: By upgrading her weapons, Tenten gains 10 points of destructible defense for 1 turn. The following turn, 'Kunai Grenade' and 'Heavenly Chain Disaster' will cost 1 less random chakra. This skill will be replaced by 'Explosive Kunais Wave' for 1 turn.

skills.name: Kunai Grenade
skills.description: Tenten throws an explosive filled with kunais at the enemy team, dealing 15 damage to one enemy and 10 damage to all other enemies. Any enemy that falls to 35 health or below will also receive 5 affliction damage*.

skills.name: Heavenly Chain Disaster
skills.description: Tenten rains blindingly fast projectiles upon the battlefield, dealing 30 piercing damage to all enemies.

skills.name: Leaping Dodge
skills.description: This skill makes Tenten (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Explosive Kunais Wave
skills.description: Tenten throws a wave of kunais with explosive tag on the enemy team, dealing 10 affliction damage to them. The following 3 turns, these enemies will be dealt 5 affliction damage each turn.

skills.name: Eight Trigams Sky Palm
skills.description: Neji deals 20 damage to one enemy. For 1 turn, if that enemy uses any new skill, they will lose 1 non-taijutsu chakra.

skills.name: Mountain Crusher Palm
skills.description: Neji destroys all destructible defense of one enemy and deals 30 damage to them, and then removes them 1 taijutsu and 1 genjutsu chakra. For 2 turns, 'Eight Trigams Sky Palm' will deal 10 additional damage to that enemy.

skills.name: Reactive Rotation
skills.description: Neji target himself or one ally for 1 turn. The first harmful non-mental skill used on the protected character will be countered, and for 3 turns will take 10 additional damage from Neji's skills. This skill is invisible.

skills.name: Neji Insight
skills.description: This skill makes Hyuuga Neji (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Leaf Great Whirlwind
skills.description: Lee gains momentum, dealing 25 piercing damage to one enemy. Afterwards, Lee will take 5 affliction damage*, which cannot kill him. Requires 'Power of Youth'.

skills.name: Maximum Force Blast
skills.description: Mixing the power of his gates, his allies, and everything he fights for, Lee deals 35 piercing damage to one enemy. The following turn, this skill will be replaced by 'Fifth Gate: Final Punch'. Requires 'Power of Youth'.

skills.name: Power of Youth
skills.description: Lee pushes himself to fight harder. If a new skill that deals damage is used on him, Lee's skills will deal 5 additional damage. While active, this skill be replaced by 'Fiery Spirit'.

skills.name: Jumping Dodge
skills.description: This skill makes Rock Lee (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Fifth Gate: Final Punch
skills.description: Lee opens the Fifth Gate of Closing, dealing 50 piercing damage to one enemy. Afterwards, Lee will take 5 affliction damage*. This skill cannot be countered.

skills.name: Fiery Spirit
skills.description: Lee hypes himself up, gaining 1 taijutsu chakra and healing 10 health and an additional 10 health for each 25 health Lee has lost.

skills.name: Lightning Beast Fang
skills.description: Kakashi forms his raikiri into a lightning dog, dealing 25 piercing damage to one enemy and stunning their skills for 1 turn. The following turn, this skill will be replaced by 'Finishing Raikiri'.

skills.name: Kakashi Kamui
skills.description: If used on an enemy, they will receive 45 piercing damage and for 1 turn the cost of their skills will be increased by 2 random. If used on an ally, all harmful effects on them will be removed and they will become invulnerable for 1 turn. This skill ignores invulnerability.

skills.name: Team Tactics
skills.description: For 3 turns, Kakashi and his team will have will have the cooldown of their skills reduced by 1 for 3 turns. The following 3 turns, 'Kakashi Kamui' will be improved and will cost 1 bloodline and 1 random chakra.

skills.name: Bunshin Stand-in
skills.description: This skill makes Hatake Kakashi (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Finishing Raikiri
skills.description: Kakashi moves to finish off an enemy, dealing 40 piercing damage to one enemy. This skill will deal an additional 10 damage to that enemy if they are stunned or if 'Lightning Beast Fang' was used on them the previous turn.

skills.name: Sanctuary Enlightenment Enclosing Palm
skills.description: Yamato uses an ancient technique that seals one enemy's power, dealing 30 piercing damage to them. Afterwards, that enemy will ignore all helpful effects for 1 turn.

skills.name: Four Column Prison
skills.description: Yamato creates a barrier of wood around one enemy or ally. If used on an enemy, that enemy will have their non-mental skills stunned and will become invulnerable to helpful skills for 2 turns. If used on an ally, that ally will gain 40 destructible defense. This skill ignores invulnerability.

skills.name: Wood Clone
skills.description: Yamato protects one ally or himself with a clone of wood for 1 turn, countering the first physical or chakra skill used against them. The countered enemy will take 20 damage* and the protected ally will gain 20 destructible defense. This skill is invisible.

skills.name: Wood Locking Wall
skills.description: This skill makes Yamato (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Gai Nunchaku Style
skills.description: Gai deals 10 damage to one enemy for 3 turns. Whenever an enemy uses a new physical skill on him, they will take 15 damage. During this time, the target of this skill will receive 10 additional damage from 'Reactive Taijutsu Rampage'.

skills.name: Reactive Taijutsu Rampage
skills.description: Gai deals 25 damage to one enemy. This skill cannot be countered or reflected.

skills.name: Gate Release
skills.description: Gai release one gate per turn, gaining 10% unpierceable damage reduction and increasing by 5 the initial damage of his skills each turn for 6 turns. During this time, he will take 5 affliction damage* and cannot be healed.This skill becomes 'Asakuujaku' permanently.

skills.name: Muscle Block
skills.description: This skill makes Maito Gai (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Asakuujaku
skills.description: Gai deals 15 piercing damage and 10 affliction damage to one enemy and stuns their skills for 1 turn. This skill cannot be countered or reflected.

skills.name: Thousand-Armed Murder
skills.description: Asuma gains 50 destructible defense and instantly deals 25 damage to one enemy. During this time, he can use this skill again for 1 random chakra to deal 25 damage to one enemy. When this skill ends, Asuma will be unable to use this skill for 1 turn.

skills.name: Ash Pile Burning
skills.description: Asuma exhales a cloud of combustible ash on all enemies, increasing the cooldown of their skills by 1 turn. During this time, this skill will be replaced by 'Ash Pile Burning - Ignite'.

skills.name: Decapitate
skills.description: Showing no mercy, Asuma targets one enemy, and if that enemy's health is 25 or less, he will instantly kill that enemy. This skill ignores invulnerability and cannot be countered or reflected.

skills.name: Asuma Evasion
skills.description: This skill makes Sarutobi Asuma (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Ash Pile Burning - Ignite
skills.description: Asuma lights up the ash on the battlefield, dealing 10 affliction damage to all enemies for each stack of 'Ash Pile Cloud' on them. This skill will end 'Ash Pile Cloud' and it cannot be countered or reflected and ignores invulnerability.

skills.name: Crow Assault
skills.description: Aoba deals 5 damage to all enemies for 4 turns. All Aoba team will also gain 5 damage reduction points for 4 turns.

skills.name: Crow Convergence
skills.description: Aoba targets one enemy, making them unable to reduce damage or become invulnerable and dealing 30 damage to them for 1 turn. For 3 turns, that enemy will take 5 additional mental damage.

skills.name: Chakra Imbued Kunai
skills.description: Aoba targets one enemy for 2 turns. If a new skill that has counter, reflect, or invulnerability is used on that enemy, they will ignore helpful effects for 1 turn. While active, that enemy will receive 10 additional damage from Aoba's skills. This skill is invisible and ends when triggered.

skills.name: Crow Smoke Screen
skills.description: This skill makes Yamashiro Aoba (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Mace Crush
skills.description: Kotetsu summons a giant mace and slams it against one enemy, dealing 30 damage to them. This skill will deal 10 more damage if the enemy has been stunned by the 'Starch Syrup Capturing Field'.

skills.name: Starch Syrup Capturing Field
skills.description: Izumo Spits out a field of sticky skyrup making it harder for the enemy team to move around. For 2 turns, any enemy that uses a new non-mental skill will have that specif class of skill stunned for 1 turn.

skills.name: Devastate
skills.description: Izumo moves to hit an enemy from the left. For the next 3 turns, if 'Annihilate' is used on that target, they will take 65 damage.

skills.name: Tag Team
skills.description: Izumo swap, exchanging his health points for Kotetsu's. If Izumo or Kotetsu is killed during this time, the other will take permanent control. During this period, 'Devastate' will be replaced by 'Annihilate'. This skill can be used again to exchange health points. This skill cannot be ignored or removed.

skills.name: Annihilate
skills.description: Kotetsu moves to hit an enemy from the right. For the next 3 turns, if 'Devastate' is used on that target, they will take 65 damage.

skills.name: Summon: Kuromaru
skills.description: Tsume calls Kuromaru to aid her. The following 4 turns, she will gain 50% points of damage reduction. During this time, this skill will be replaced by 'Fierce Bite' and any enemy that uses a new harmful non-affliction skill on Tsume will receive 10 damage.

skills.name: Passing Fang
skills.description: Tsume spins, dealing 15 piercing damage to one enemy for 2 turns. All stun skills that enemy uses will also be decreased by 2 turns. If 'Summon: Kuromaru' is active, this skill will deal 5 additional damage.

skills.name: Flashbang
