skills.description: Tsume covers herself and her allies, making them invulnerable to all non-affliction skills for 1 turn. Tsume only carries 3 of these grenades with her at all times, so this skill can only be used three times in a game.

skills.name: Man-Beast Defense
skills.description: This skill makes Inuzuka Tsume (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Fierce Bite
skills.description: Kuromaru jumps at one enemy dealing 25 damage which ignores invulnerability. If that enemy dies this turn, then for 2 turns Tsume will have her damage increased by 10, will ignore all stun effects and cannot be killed.

skills.name: Mastered Mind Disturbance
skills.description: Inoichi invades an enemy's mind, dealing 10 piercing damage to them and stunning their non-mental skills for 1 turn. If used one turn after 'Mind Shatter', this skill will deal 10 additional damage.

skills.name: Mind Shatter
skills.description: Inoichi deals 30 piercing damage to one enemy. For 1 turn, that enemy's physical skills will cost 1 additional taijutsu chakra, their chakra skills will cost 1 additional ninjutsu chakra, their mental skills will cost 1 additional genjutsu chakra, and their affliction skills will cost 1 additional bloodline chakra.

skills.name: Mental Invasion
skills.description: For 1 turn, if one enemy uses a new harmful skill, that skill will heal instead of dealing damage, and its non-damage effects will be nullified. This skill is invisible.

skills.name: Sensing Water Sphere
skills.description: This skill makes Yamanaka Inoichi (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Payback
skills.description: Ibiki deals 5 affliction damage to one enemy permanently. During this time, if that enemy's health drops to 15 or less, they will be instantly killed. While active, Ibiki's other harmful skills will cost 1 less random chakra. This skill ends when Ibiki or the target dies and cannot be used while active.

skills.name: Summoning: Iron Maiden
skills.description: Ibiki summons a giant cat and traps one enemy inside of it, dealing 20 piercing damage to that enemy. For 2 turns, each turn that enemy uses a new harmful skill, they will be dealt 20 piercing damage. Ibiki will also gain 20 destructible defense when this skill is used.

skills.name: Summoning: Torture Chamber
skills.description: Ibiki traps one enemy inside his torture chambers, dealing 20 piercing damage to that enemy. For 2 turns, each turn that enemy does not use a new skill, they will be dealt 20 piercing damage. Ibiki will also gain 20 destructible defense when this skill is used.

skills.name: Sliding Evasion
skills.description: This skill makes Morino Ibiki (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Chain Bind
skills.description: Chouza slows down an enemy, dealing 10 damage to them and lowering all physical and chakra damage they deal by 10 for 1 turn. During this time, Chouza's team will also gain 10 destructible defense.

skills.name: Jounin Meat Tank
skills.description: Chouza begins rolling, dealing 15 damage to all enemies for 2 turns. During this time, his team will gain 15 destructible defense each turn.

skills.name: Expansion Smash
skills.description: If used on an enemy, for 1 turn, the next non-mental harmful skill they use will be countered. If used on an ally, for 1 turn, the next non-mental harmful skill used on them will be countered. The countered enemy will receive 20 damage. This skill is invisible.

skills.name: Chouza Block
skills.description: This skill makes Akimichi Chouza (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Master Gentle Fist
skills.description: Hiashi slams one enemy with his fists, dealing 25 damage to them and removing 1 random chakra from them. The following turn, one other random enemy will receive 20 damage and lose 1 taijutsu or ninjutsu chakra. The target of this skill is invisible.

skills.name: Master Revolving Heaven
skills.description: Hiashi spins, becoming invulnerable for 2 turns, dealing 15 damage to one enemy and 10 to all others each turn.

skills.name: Eight Trigrams Vacuum Wall Palm
skills.description: Hiashi gets ready to blast an enemy's attack back. The next turn, the first enemy to use a new harmful skill on one ally or himself will have that skill reflected back to one random enemy.

skills.name: Hiashi Byakugan
skills.description: This skill makes Hyuuga Hiashi (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Master Shadow Imitation
skills.description: Shikaku grabs an enemy with his shadow, forcing their body to do as he pleases. That enemy will take 20 damage and have their non-mental skills stunned for 2 turns. The following turn, this skill will be replaced by 'Shadow Dispersion'.

skills.name: Black Spider Lily
skills.description: Shikaku extends his shadows out to his enemies. For 3 turns, Shikaku's skills will deal an additional 10 damage to them, and each time they use a new stun skill, then for 3 turns the next time Shikaku stuns that enemy, they will be stunned for 1 additional turn.

skills.name: Problem Analysis
skills.description: Shikaku targets himself or one ally for 1 turn, and the first new harmful non-affliction damage skill that is used on them will deal no damage and that ally will gain destructible defense equal to the original damage of that skill. This skill is invisible.

skills.name: Human Barricade
skills.description: This skill makes Nara Shikaku (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Shadow Dispersion
skills.description: Nara Shikaku targets all enemies not affected by 'Master Shadow Imitation', stunning their non-mental skills for 1 turn and dealing 20 damage to them.

skills.name: Full Team Recovery
skills.description: Shizune instantly heals herself and her allies for 15 health. During 'Chakra Reinforcement', this skill will heal Shizune and her allies for 20 health.

skills.name: Katsuyu Interception
skills.description: Shizune calls upon Katsuyu to protect herself or an ally. For 1 turn, the first harmful skill used on the protected ally will be countered. This skill is invisible.

skills.name: Chakra Reinforcement
skills.description: For 3 turns, Shizune will have 10 points of damage reduction. During this time, 'Full Team Recovery' will be improved. The following 3 turns, this skill will be replaced by 'Four-Corner Sealing Barrier'.

skills.name: Sliding Dodge
skills.description: This skill makes Shizune (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Four-Corner Sealing Barrier
skills.description: Shizune seals one enemy inside a four-corner barrier, dealing 25 damage to them. Afterwards, Shizune will become invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Armor of Venom
skills.description: Torune applies one 'Venom Beetle' to one enemy and gains 15 destructible defense. During this time, Torune can use this skill again for 1 random chakra to apply a 'Venom Beetle' to one enemy. The enemy that destroys this destructible defense will have a 'Venom Beetle' applied to them.

skills.name: Jar of Poison
skills.description: Torune applies one 'Venom Beetle' to each enemy and gains 35 destructible defense. During this time, Torune can use this skill again for 2 random chakra to apply a 'Venom Beetle' to each enemy. The enemy that destroys this destructible defense will have a 'Venom Beetle' applied to them.

skills.name: Venom Explosion
skills.description: Torune targets any enemy affected by at least one 'Venom Beetle', removing 1 random chakra from them for each 'Venom Beetle' on them.

skills.name: Super Leap
skills.description: This skill makes Aburame Torune (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Venom Beetle
skills.description: This skill deals 5 affliction damage permanently.

skills.name: Tanto Slash
skills.description: Fu slashes with his tanto, dealing 25 damage to one enemy. This skill will deal 15 additional damage to an enemy countered by 'Mind Puppet Switch'.

skills.name: Quickened Mind Body Switch
skills.description: Fu disrupts one enemy, dealing 20 piercing damage to them. For 1 turn, that enemy will be invulnerable to helpful skills. The following turn, 'Tanto Slash' will deal 15 additional damage to that enemy.

skills.name: Mind Puppet Switch
skills.description: Fu sets up a trap using a puppet. For 1 turn, the first enemy that uses a new harmful physical or chakra skill against Fu or one ally will be countered and will have all their skills replaced by 'Mind Puppet Switch - Attack' for 2 turns, and this skill will end.

skills.name: Aggresive Retreat
skills.description: This skill makes Yamanaka Fu (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Mind Puppet Switch - Attack
skills.description: This skill deals 15 damage to one enemy.

skills.name: Izanagi
skills.description: Danzo consumes 2 "Izanagi's Sharingan" to activate Izanagi, ignoring all damage dealt to him permanently. If Danzo is affected by 2 new harmful skills, this skill will end and Danzo will be unable to use it for 1 turn. While 'Izanagi' is activated, this skill will be replaced by 'Stolen Kotoamatsukami'.

skills.name: Self-Cursing Seal
skills.description: Danzo places a seal mark on an enemy's body, dealing 10 affliction damage to them for 5 turns. If this skill is removed, that enemy will have their harmful skills stunned for 1 turn. This skill stacks.

skills.name: Summoning: Baku
skills.description: Danzo summons Baku in the battlefield, dealing 25 piercing damage to one enemy. For 2 turns, that enemy's non-affliction skills will deal 50% less damage.

skills.name: Tree Birth Defense
skills.description: This skill makes Shimura Danzo (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Izanagi's Sharingan
skills.description: Danzo starts the game with 10 Sharingans. Each time Danzo uses 'Izanagi', he will consume 2 Sharingan to ignore all damage dealt to him until 2 new harmful skill are used on him. If Danzo runs out of Sharingans, 'Izanagi' will be replaced by 'Reverse Four Symbols Seal' permanently.

skills.name: Stolen Kotoamatsukami
skills.description: The next time one enemy uses a new harmful skill, they will be countered. The following 2 turns, that enemy will have their harmful skills stunned and this skill will be replaced by the countered skill and will have no cost. This skill cannot be countered, reflected and is invisible.

skills.name: Reverse Four Symbols Seal
skills.description: Danzo releases 4 symbol from his blood and forms a large black sphere around him, sealing all enemies and dealing 20 affliction damage to them. Afterwards, Danzo takes 10 affliction damage.

skills.name: White Secret Attack Rampage
skills.description: Chiyo directs her puppets to devastate the battlefield, dealing 20 damage to a random enemy for 1 turn. The following turn, a second random enemy will also be dealt 20 damage. The second target is invisible. The next use of 'Sanbou Kyuukai' will deal 5 aditional damage. This skill stacks.

skills.name: Sanbou Kyuukai
skills.description: This skill deals 20 piercing damage to one enemy and stuns their physical and chakra skills for 1 turn. Also for 1 turn, that enemy will receive 5 additional damage from all sources. This skill ignores invulnerability.

skills.name: Ally Puppetry

skills.description: This skill makes Juugo (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Psychotic Break
skills.description: Juugo loses his mind and assaults one enemy, stealing 10 health from them for 3 turns. During this time, if that enemy uses a new harmful skill, Jugoo's skills will be improved and will cost random chakra for 1 turn.

skills.name: Chakra Cannons
skills.description: Juugo uses his jet booster-like appendages to charge chakra and blast a powerful chakra blast, dealing 45 damage to one enemy. While improved, this skill will cost 2 random chakra.

skills.name: Body Absorption
skills.description: Juugo absorbs one enemy's body, stealing 15 health from them and making that enemy unable to reduce damage or become invulnerable for 2 turns. For 1 turn, Juugo will ignore all harmful effects except damage. While improved, this skill will cost 1 random chakra.

skills.name: Juugo Block
skills.description: This skill makes Cursed Seal Juugo (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Chidori Surprise Attack
skills.description: Sasuke catches one enemy off guard with Chidori, dealing 20 piercing damage to them. The following 3 turns, Sasuke's skills will deal 10 additional damage.

skills.name: Cursed Seal: Automatic Protection
skills.description: For 1 turn, the first harmful skill used on Sasuke will be countered. If successful, the countered enemy will take 10 piercing damage and Sasuke will gain 10 points of destructible defense. This skill is invisible.

skills.name: Kirin
skills.description: Harnessing natural lightning from the storm clouds above, Sasuke guides a massive thunderbolt onto one enemy, dealing 35 piercing damage to them. If that enemy's health drops to 15 or lower, they will be instantly killed. This skill cannot be countered.

skills.name: Sasuke Kunai Parry
skills.description: This skill makes Hebi Sasuke (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Amaterasu Wave
skills.description: Using his Amaterasu in the battlefield, Sasuke deals 12 affliction damage to all enemies for 2 turns. While active, any enemy that does not use a new skill will make 'Amaterasu Wave' last 1 turn longer on them. This skill cannot be used on enemies already affected by it and it cannot be removed.

skills.name: Enton Amaterasu
skills.description: Sasuke uses his Amaterasu as a shield on himself for 4 turns, granting him 15 points of destructible defense. During this time, any enemy that uses a new non-mental skill on Sasuke will *receive 5 affliction damage permanently. This skill stacks.

skills.name: Dark Genjutsu
skills.description: Mangekyou Sasuke (S) deals 25 piercing damage to one enemy. That enemy's non-mental skills will be stunned for 1 turn.

skills.name: Hawk Summoning
skills.description: This skill makes Mangekyou Sasuke (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Sasuke Susano'o
skills.description: Using his Susanoo, Sasuke gains 50 points of destructible defense permanent and may use his skills. During this time, this skill is replaced and Sasuke will ignore any effects that destroy destructible defense. When this defense is destroyed, Sasuke will be stunned for 2 turns.

skills.name: Susano'o Arrow
skills.description: Using his Susano'o bow, Sasuke destroys all destructible defense of one enemy and deals 20 piercing damage and an additional 5 damage for each 10 points of destructible defense that 'Sasuke Susano'o' currently has. This skill requires 'Sasuke Susano'o'.

skills.name: Spreading Amaterasu
skills.description: Susanoo Sasuke deals 2 affliction damage to one enemy permanently. This skill will double its damage everytime that enemy uses a new skill. This skill cannot be removed and it requires 'Sasuke Susano'o'. This skill will have its cooldown reset if the enemy target is killed.

skills.name: Mangekyo Insight
skills.description: This skill makes Susanoo Sasuke (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Sasuke Mangekyo Sharingan
skills.description: Sasuke activates his Mangekyou Sharingan and gains 25% unpierceable damage reduction until 'Sasuke Susano'o' destructible defense is destroyed. When this skill is used, the cooldown of 'Spreading Amaterasu' is reset.

skills.name: Lightning Release
skills.description: Using lightning, Raikage will permanently deal 10 additional damage until he uses a new harmful skill. While active, he gains 10 points of damage reduction. Each time this skill is used, it costs 1 additional random chakra, its bonus damage increases by 10, and grants 5 additional points of damage reduction.

skills.name: Liger Bomb
skills.description: Raikage lifts one enemy in the air and then brutaly smashes their head fist into ground, dealing 30 damage to them and lowering their non-affliction damage by 15 for 1 turn. The following turn, that enemy's skills will be stunned.

skills.name: Lightning Oppression Horizontal
skills.description: Raikage performs a backhanded horizontal chop againts one enemy, destroying all destructible defense and dealing 20 piercing damage.

skills.name: Lightning Speed
skills.description: This skill makes Raikage (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Lava Wall
skills.description: Terumi Mei uses a lava wall, dealing 25 affliction damage to one enemy and stunning their physical and chakra skills for 1 turn. This skill cannot be countered or reflected. During 'Prision Lava Wall', this skill will deal 35 affliction damage and cost 1 additional random chakra.

skills.name: Prision Lava Wall
skills.description: Terumi Mei creates a prison of lava, dealing 5 affliction damage to all enemies for 3 turns. During this time, each turn a random enemy will become invulnerable to helpful skills. 'Lava Wall' and 'Skilled Mist' will be improved during this skill*.

skills.name: Skilled Mist
skills.description: Terumi Mei uses Skilled Mist to destroy all enemies' destructible defense and deal 15 affliction damage to them for 2 turns. This skill cannot be countered, reflected, or removed. During 'Prision Lava Wall', this skill will deal 5 additional affliction damage.

skills.name: Fast Evade
skills.description: This skill makes Mizukage (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Detachment of Primitive World
skills.description: Ohnoki isolates an enemy with his dust release, dealing 10 affliction damage to them. For 1 turn, that enemy will be invulnerable to helpful skills and their harmful skills will be stunned. The following turn, this skill will be replaced by 'Dust Implode'.

skills.name: Super-Weighted Boulder Technique
skills.description: Onhoki touches an enemy and makes them much heavier. For 2 turns, the cost of their harmful skills will be increased by 1 random chakra.

skills.name: Rock Fist
skills.description: Increasing his striking power with Rock Fist, Ohnoki deals 30 damage to one enemy. Afterwards, Ohnoki gains 15 permanent destructible defense.

skills.name: Effortless Flight
skills.description: This skill makes Tsuchikage (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Dust Implode
skills.description: Ohnoki incinerates an enemey trapped by 'Detachment of Primitive World' into mere particles, removing all helpful skills from that enemy and dealing 40 damage to them. This skill cannot be ignored or countered.

skills.name: Heavenly Spear Kick
skills.description: Tsunade spears one enemy with her foot, destroying all their destructible defense and dealing 20 piercing damage to them. For 1 turn, that enemy's physical skills will deal 15 less non-affliction damage. While empowered, this skill will deal 40 piercing damage instead.

skills.name: Enhanced Healing Wave
skills.description: Tsunade pours chakra into one ally, healing them for 30 health. Additionally, that character will heal an additional 10 health for 2 turns. If empowered, this skill will heal 40 health and the secondary effect will last an additional 1 turn.

skills.name: Tsunade: Strength of a Hundred Seal
skills.description: Tsunade taps into her seal. If Tsunade has 75 health or less, she will instantly heal 15 health. The next time Tsunade uses a skill, it will be empowered. If this skill is used while empowered, it will heal Tsunade 50 health and grant her 2 random chakra.

skills.name: Tsunade Protection
skills.description: This skill makes Tsunade (S) invulnerable for 1 turn. This skill is not affected by 'Tsunade: Strength of a Hundred Seal'.

skills.name: Samurai Troops
skills.description: By commanding his samurai troops, Mifune deals 5 piercing damage to all enemies and makes them deal 5 less non-affliction damage for 1 turn. Also for 1 turn, all Mifune team will deal 5 more damage from melee skills. This skill becomes 'Flash' with a bloodline cost.

skills.name: Iaito
skills.description: Reacting one enemy move, Mifune deals them 15 piercing damage and becomes invulnerable from physical skills for 1 turn. This skill becomes 'Flash' with a taijutsu cost.

skills.name: Raiton Pierce
skills.description: Mifuse uses a fast lightning chakra stab to one enemy, dealing them 15 piercing damage and makes them invulnerable from new helpful skills. This skill becomes 'Flash' with a genjutsu cost.

skills.name: Samurai Guard
skills.description: This skill makes Mifune (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Flash
skills.description: With his more powerful cut, Mifune deals 30 piercing damage to one enemy and stuns their non-mental skills. This skill costs a specific chakra depending on the skill that is replaced by it.

skills.name: Wood Release: Wood Dragon
skills.description: Hashirama creates a wooden dragon that drains chakra. For 2 turns, Hashirama will become invulnerable to all chakra skills* and for 2 turns, Hashirama will steal 1 taijutsu or ninjutsu chakra from one enemy.

skills.name: Wood Release: Wood Human
skills.description: Creating a giant statue of a human, for 2 turns, Hashirama will become invulnerable to all physical skills* and for 2 turns, Hashirama will deal 20 damage to one enemy.

skills.name: Wood Release: True Thousand Hands
skills.description: Hashirama summons a giant buddha that grants 30 destructible defense to Hashirama and his allies and for 3 turns, if used, 'Wood Release: Wood Dragon' and 'Wood Release: Wood Human' will last 1 additional turn and cost 1 less random chakra.

skills.name: Sage Knowledge
skills.description: This skill makes Senju Hashirama invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Eternal Mangekyou
skills.description: Madara uses his Eternal Mangekyou Sharingan. For 4 turns, all non-affliction damage used against him will be reduced to a maximum of 25. During this time, Madara can use this skill again for no cost to ignore all harmful effects except damage for 1 turn.

skills.name: Great Fire Annihilation
skills.description: Madara immolates the entire battlefield, dealing 10 affliction damage to one enemy and 5 to all others for 3 turns. During this time, if an enemy uses a new helpful skill, they will receive 10 affliction damage. While 'Eternal Mangekyou' is active, this skill is improved and will have no cooldown.

skills.name: Madara: Susanoo
skills.description: Madara encases himself in his Susanoo, gaining 70 destructible defense. During this time, this skill will be replaced by 'Armored Susanoo Assault'. Using this skill will reset the stacks of 'Armored Susanoo Assault'.

skills.name: Emergency Susanoo Defense
skills.description: This skill makes Uchiha Madara invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Armored Susanoo Assault
skills.description: Madara's Susanoo armors up and attacks one enemy with its sword, dealing 30 damage to them and an additional 5 damage for each turn that 'Madara: Susanoo' has been active. This skill cannot be countered.

skills.name: Shisui: Susanoo
skills.description: Shisui activates his still immature Susanoo, gaining 45 destructible defense. During this time, this skill will be replaced by 'Tsukumo'. Using this skill will reset the stacks of 'Tsukumo'.

skills.name: Body Flicker
skills.description: For 2 turns, if a new harmful skill is used on Shisui, he will become invulnerable to all other skills for the rest of that turn and will deal 15 damage to the enemy that used the harmful skill. This skill is invisible.

skills.name: Kotoamatsukami
skills.description: Shisui activates one of the most powerful genjutsu and targets one enemy. For 1 turn, the first harmful skill used by that enemy will also be applied on a random member of that enemy's team. The following turn, the target will be dealt 25 piercing damage. This skill is invisible and ignores invulnerability.

skills.name: Shisui Intercept
skills.description: This skill makes Uchiha Shisui (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Tsukumo
skills.description: Shisui activates his Susanoo's power, sending out a barrage of chakra needles dealing 15 damage to all enemies and reducing their non-affliction damage by 5. For each turn that 'Shisui: Susanoo' is activated, the damage reducing effect will last 1 additional turn.

skills.name: Soap Bubble
skills.description: Utakata deals 10 piercing damage to one enemy and applies 'Bubble Prision' on them. 'Bubble Prision' deals 5 unremovable affliction damage to one enemy, and the first time that enemy uses a new harmful skill, it will cause 'Soap Bubble' to cost 1 random chakra until the next use of it.

skills.name: Drowning Bubble Jutsu
skills.description: Utakata targets all enemies affected by 'Bubble Prision' and stuns their non-mental skills for 1 turn. These enemies will also receive 5 additional damage from 'Bubble Prision' and will lose 1 random chakra for each stack of 'Bubble Prision' on them. Cannot be countered, reflected and ignores invulnerability.

skills.name: Rokubi Transformation
skills.description: Utakata heals 10 health for each time 'Soap Bubble' was used. Afterwards, he becomes invulnerable to Physical and Chakra skills for 2 turns. This skill removes all stacks from 'Soap Bubble'.

skills.name: Bubble Dome
skills.description: This skill makes Utakata (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Bubble Prision
skills.description: This skill deals 5 unremovable affliction damage to a target permanently. The first time that enemy uses a new harmful skill, it will cause 'Soap Bubble' to cost 1 random chakra until the next use of it.

skills.name: Isobu: Tailed Beast Bomb
skills.description: Yagura heals 5 health and deals 20 damage to one enemy. This skill  deals 10 additional damage  for every 15 extra health it heals.

skills.name: Bloodshed
skills.description: Yagura deals 10 piercing damage to all enemies. For 2 turns, if an enemy does not use a new skill, their skills will have 1 additional cooldown for 1 turn, otherwise, 'Isobu: Tailed Beast Bomb' will heal 5 additional health permanently. This skill stacks and cannot be countered.

skills.name: Isobu Transformation
skills.description: For 1 turn, Yagura will ignore stun effects and 'Bloodshed' will cost 1 random chakra. Permanently, everytime Yagura uses a new skill, he will ignore all stun effects for 1 turn. During this time, this skill can be used to make 'Bloodshed'  cost 1 random chakra for 1 turn. This skill cannot be removed.

skills.name: Isobu: Chakra Skin
skills.description: This skill makes Yagura invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Crystal Dragon
skills.description: Guren sends a massive crystal dragon towards one enemy, dealing 35 damage to them and stunning their skills for 1 turn. The following turn, that enemy will receive 10 additional damage from 'Crystal Barrage'. This skill will be replaced by 'Crystal Barrage' permanently.

skills.name: Crystal Prison
skills.description: Guren encases an enemy in a crystal prison. For 1 turn, that enemy will become invulnerable to helpful skills. The following turn, this skill will be replaced 'Crystal Break'.

skills.name: Crystal Clone
skills.description: Guren forms a crystal clone. For 1 turn, the first harmful skill used against her will be countered, and the countered enemy will take 20 piercing damage*. This skill is invisible and ends when triggered.

skills.name: Crystal Formation: Arrow of Light
skills.description: This skill makes Guren (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Crystal Barrage
skills.description: Guren unleashes a barrage of crystal spikes, dealing 25 damage to all enemis. After this skill is used, it will be replaced by 'Crystal Dragon'.

skills.name: Crystal Break
skills.description: Guren crushes the enemy affected by 'Crystal Prison', dealing 30 piercing damage to them.

skills.name: Clay Molds
skills.description: For 3 turns, Deidara gains 5 permanent destructible defense and activates "C2" first turn. Second turn he activates "C3". Third turn he activates "C4". Afterwards, this skill is restarted and Deidara gains 1 random chakra.

skills.name: C3 - Giant Doll
skills.description: Deidara deals 15 piercing damage to all enemies. During "C2", this skill deals 5 additional damage. During "C3", this skill deals 10 additional damage and stuns one random enemy's harmful skills for 1 turn. During "C4", this skill stuns all enemies' harmful skills for 1 turn. Requires 'Clay Mold'.

skills.name: C2 - Clay Centipede
skills.description: Deidara deals 10 damage to one enemy for 2 turns. The target's draining chakra effects will not be applied. If used during "C2", this skill lasts 3 turns. If used during "C3", Deidara becomes invulnerable to non-mental skills for 1 turn. During "C4", this skill lasts 1 turn and deals 30 piercing damage. Requires 'Clay Mold'.

skills.name: Aerial Retreat
skills.description: This skill makes Deidara (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Clay Dolls
skills.description: Deidara gains 15 points of destructible defense. While he has this defense up, each turn he will target a random enemy, dealing 10 damage to them and making them receive 5 additional non-affliction damage from Deidara's other skills.

skills.name: C2: Dragon
skills.description: For 3 turns, Deidara gains 20 points of destructible defense and targets all enemies. Any enemy that uses a new harmful skill will take 10 piercing damage. While active, this skill will be replaced by 'Dragon Missile'.

skills.name: C4: Karura
skills.description: Deidara releases a cloud of microscopic bomb towards on enemy, dealing 3 affliction damage to them permanently. This skill will double its damage each turn.

skills.name: C4: Trap
skills.description: This skill makes True Art Deidara (S) invulnerable for 1 turn. After Deidara uses 5 new skills, 'C4: Trap' will be replaced by 'C0: Final Explosion'.

skills.name: Dragon Missile
skills.description: Deidara deals 25 damage to one enemy. This skill ignores invulnerability.

skills.name: C0: Final Explosion
skills.description: Deidara sacrifices himself, dealing 40 piercing damage to all enemies. Afterwards, Deidara is instantly killed. This skill may only be used when Deidara uses 5 new skills.

skills.name: Poisonous Tail Stab
skills.description: Deals 15 affliction damage to one enemy and applies 'Venom Stack'. This skill will cost 1 random chakra for 1 turn after being used. If the target already has a 'Venom Stack', deals 5 additional damage per stack and applies a 'Venom Stack' to all other enemies.

skills.name: Sand Clone Trap
skills.description: For 1 turn, Hiruko or an ally ignores all damage. During this turn, each enemy that uses a new skill on them takes 10 affliction damage* and gains 1 'Venom Stack'. This skill is invisible. This skill ends if Hiruko dies.

skills.name: Puppet Reveal
skills.description: Sasori activates 'Puppet Reveal'. The next time his health reaches 50 or less, he will gain 20 points of destructible defense for 3 turns. During this time, 'Sand Clone Trap' and 'Puppet Reveal' will be replaced. This skill is invisible and can only be used once.

skills.name: Tail Deflection
skills.description: This skill makes Hiruko Sasori (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Eight Waves of Needles
skills.description: Applies 2 'Needle Marks' to all enemies for 2 turns. When an enemy with 'Needle Marks' receives damage from Hiruko or his allies, removes 1 mark to deal 10 affliction damage.

skills.name: Prosthetic Arm Senbon
skills.description: Consumes all 'Needle Marks' on all enemies: for each mark removed, that enemy takes 15 affliction damage; if at least 5 marks are consumed in total, Sasori becomes invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Poison Stack
skills.description: Venom Stack: The following turn, this enemy receives 5 affliction damage for 2 turns.

skills.name: Five Man-Eating Sharks
skills.description: Kisame summons five sharks of water, dealing 25 damage to one enemy for 2 turns. During this time, that enemy will deal 10 less non-affliction damage. During 'Explosive Water Shock Wave', this skill will cost 1 less random chakra.

skills.name: Water Prison Technique
skills.description: Using a bubble of water, Kisame deals 15 affliction damage to one enemy and stuns their non-mental skills for 1 turn. During this time, that enemy will become invulnerable to helpful skills. During 'Explosive Water Shock Wave', this skill will cost 1 random chakra.

skills.name: Explosive Water Shock Wave
skills.description: Kisame fills the battlefield with water. For 4 turns, Kisame and his allies will lose 1 less chakra from chakra removal or stealing effects used on them and all enemies that use a new skill will have the cooldown of that skill increased by 1 turn.

skills.name: Kisame Water Clone
skills.description: This skill makes Kisame Body Double (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Finger Genjutsu
skills.description: Itachi affects one enemy with Finger Genjutsu for 1 turn. If the affected enemy uses any skill on Itachi Body Double (S) or his allies that skill will be countered and that enemy will take 10 damage and Itachi Body Double (S) will gain 1 genjutsu chakra. The target of this skill is invisible.

skills.name: Genjutsu Reversal
skills.description: For 2 turns, the first harmful skill used on Itachi Body Double (S) each turn will be reflected back onto the enemy who used it. This skill is invisible.

skills.name: Goukakyuu no Jutsu
skills.description: Itachi Body Double (S) creates a large fireball that scorches the battlefield, dealing 20 affliction damage to one enemy. The following turn, all enemies will take 10 affliction damage.*

skills.name: Illusionary Raven Bunshin
skills.description: This skill makes Itachi Body Double (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Thousand Hands
skills.description: Using this skill, Sasori deals 10 damage to an enemy for 2 turns and gains 5 points of destructible defense each turn. If 'Poison Gas' is used on the target in the following turn, it will last 1 additional turn on them.

skills.name: Poison Gas
skills.description: Sasori deals 5 affliction damage to all enemies for 5 turns. During this time, Sasori gains 5 points of destructible defense and any enemy that uses a new harmful skill will be dealt 5 affliction damage. This skill lasts 1 additional turn on an enemy affected by 'Thousand Hands'. This skill cannot be countered and ends when Sasori is killed.

skills.name: Iron Sand
skills.description: Sasori summons the Third Kazekage's puppet for 3 turns. Each turn, Sasori gains 10 permanent destructible defense and any enemy that uses a new harmful skill on Sasori will take 5 piercing damage. During this time, this skill becomes 'Satetsu Kaiho' and 'Thousand Hands' becomes 'Satetsu Kesshu'.

skills.name: Puppet Protection
skills.description: This skill makes Sasori invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Satetsu Kaiho
skills.description: Sasori gathers a great volume of iron sand. This skill deals 30 piercing damage to one enemy. For 2 turns, that enemy will be unable to reduce damage or become invulnerable. Afterwards, Sasori gains 15 points of destructible defense for 1 turn.

skills.name: Satetsu Kesshu
skills.description: Sasori creates a giant sphere of branching spikes. This skill deals 25 piercing damage to all enemies. If an enemy's health drops to 10 or lower, they will be killed. This skill cannot be countered or reflected.

skills.name: Puppet Flamethrower
skills.description: Sasori deals 10 affliction damage to one enemy. The following turn, that enemy will be dealt 5 affliction damage permanently. If used on an enemy affected by 'Water Stream Shooters', this skill will have a different effect, dealing 20 affliction damage and stunning harmful skills for 1 turn.

skills.name: Water Stream Shooters
skills.description: Sasori deals 10 affliction damage to one enemy. The following turn, that enemy will be dealt 5 affliction damage permanently. If used on an enemy affected by 'Puppet Flamethrower', this skill will have a different effect, dealing 30 affliction damage and stunning helpful skills for 1 turn.

skills.name: Red Secret Technique: 100 Puppets
skills.description: Sasori uses the Red Secret Technique, summoning one hundred puppets and gaining 50 points of destructible defense. Permanently, all enemies will be dealt 15 piercing damage each turn. This skill will end if Sasori successfully receives damage.

skills.name: Magnificent Pose
skills.description: This skill makes True Form Sasori invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Reaping Scythe
skills.description: Hidan (S) attacks one enemy with his scythe dealing 15 damage to them and he gains 10 permanent destructible defense. 'Curse of Jashin' may be used on the targeted enemy the following turn. This skill cannot be used on an enemy affected by 'Curse of Jashin'.

skills.name: Curse of Jashin
skills.description: Hidan curses an enemy. For 2 turns, all harmful skills used on Hidan will be reflected upon the cursed enemy. During this time, 'Impale' may be used. This skill ignores invulnerability and cannot be countered or reflected.

skills.name: Impale
skills.description: Hidan (S) impales himself with a large metal spike dealing 40 piercing damage to one enemy currently the target of 'Curse of Jashin' and removes 1 bloodline or ninjutsu chakra from them. This skill ignores invulnerability.

skills.name: Immortality
skills.description: This skill makes Hidan (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Fuuton Atsugai
skills.description: Fuuton Atsugai deals 30 damage to one enemy and stuns their non-affliction skills for 1 turn. The following turn, this skill will be replaced by 'Katon Zukokku'.

skills.name: Raiton Gian
skills.description: Raiton Gian deals 30 piercing damage to one enemy. The following turn, this skill will be replaced by 'Inferno Gust'.

skills.name: Heart Steal
skills.description: Using his tendrils, Kakuzu rips the heart out of one enemy and makes it his own. Kakuzu instantly kills that enemy and heals 35 health. This skill can only be used on an enemy at or below 35 health. This skill ignores invulnerability.

skills.name: Iron Skin Technique
skills.description: This skill makes Kakuzu (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Katon Zukokku
skills.description: Katon Zukokku deals 15 affliction damage to all enemies.

skills.name: Inferno Gust
skills.description: Inferno gust deal 40 damage to one enemy and 15 to all other enemies.

skills.name: Hungry Sharks
skills.description: Kisame summons one hungry shark for each enemy alive, dealing 5 piercing damage to all of them permanently. Each turn, the first enemy to use a new harmful skill will be marked, causing all other hungry sharks to attack only the marked enemy next turn. This skill cannot be removed; Ends if Kisame dies.

skills.name: Shark Bomb
skills.description: Kisame blasts an enemy with his shark bomb, dealing 30 damage and removing 1 bloodline or ninjutsu from them. For this turn, that enemy will receive 5 additional damage from 'Hungry Sharks'.

skills.name: Samehada Guard
skills.description: Samehada protects Kisame with his spikes. For 1 turn, the first enemy to use a new non-mental skill on Kisame will be countered. If sucessfully, Kisame deal 15 piercing damage and steal 1 taijutsu or bloodline chakra from that enemy. This skill is invisible.

skills.name: Water Isolation
skills.description: This skill makes Hoshigaki Kisame (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Water Prison Shark Dance
skills.description: For 3 turns, all enemies and all allies will have the cost of their harmful skills increased by 1 random chakra, while Kisame's harmful skills will cost 1 less random chakra. During this time, any target that uses a new harmful skill will ignore 'Water Prison Shark Dance' for 1 turn. This skill ends when Kisame dies.

skills.name: Non-Stop Hunting
skills.description: Kisame relentlessly hunts an enemy from underwater. For 2 turns, Kisame will deal 20 piercing damage to that enemy and remove 1 random chakra from them each turn.

skills.name: Great Water Shark Missile
skills.description: Kisame launches a massive shark-shaped water missile, dealing 25 damage to all enemies and removing 1 random chakra from a random enemy. Afterwards, Kisame gains 15 points of destructible defense. This skill cannot be countered.

skills.name: Shark Skin
skills.description: This skill makes Samehada Fusion Kisame (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Amaterasu Field
skills.description: Itachi creates a field around his team using Amaterasu. For 1 turn, any enemy that uses a new skill on Itachi (S) or his allies will be dealt 5 affliction damage permanently*. This skill is invisible.

skills.name: Crow Genjutsu
skills.description: Itachi places a genjutsu on one enemy. For 1 turn, if that enemy uses a new harmful skill they will be countered. If successfully, the countered enemy's skills will cost 1 additional random chakra until they use a new skill. This skill is invisible.

skills.name: Mastered Mangekyou Sharingan
skills.description: Itachi uses his mastered mangekyou sharingan to deceive an enemy. For 1 turn, the first new skill used by that enemy will be reflected to a random different enemy. This skill is invisible and ignores invulnerability.

skills.name: Clone Genjutsu
skills.description: This skill makes Uchiha Itachi (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Susanoo Activation
skills.description: Uchiha Itachi activates Susanoo, and he takes 20 affliction damage*. Each turn he gains 5 permanent stacking destructible defense and his skills become usable for the rest of the game. This skill cannot be used while it's active.

skills.name: Totsuka Sword
skills.description: Itachi uses the legendary blade of Susanoo, dealing 25 piercing damage to one enemy and removing 1 genjutsu or bloodline chakra from them. This skill requires 'Susanoo Activation'.'

skills.name: Yata Mirror
skills.description: Using the legendary shield of Susanoo, Itachi (S) ignores all harmful effects used on him for 1 turn. Any enemy that uses a new skill on him will have the cost of their skills increased by 1 random chakra for 1 turn. This skill is invisible and requires 'Susanoo Activation'.

skills.name: Susanoo Defense
skills.description: This skill makes Susanoo Itachi (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Sword of Paper
skills.description: Using a sword made of paper, Konan deals 25 piercing damage to one enemy.

skills.name: Origami Blanket
skills.description: Konan covers one enemy in paper, dealing 15 damage to them for 2 turns. Each turn, that enemy will have their harmful skills stunned and become invulnerable to helpful skills. The following 2 turns, they will receive 10 additional damage from 'Sword of Paper'.

skills.name: Dance Of The Shikigami
skills.description: Konan transforms her body into countless sheets of paper and strikes her enemies, dealing 25 damage to one enemy and 25 damage to a different random enemy.

skills.name: Onmyoji Dodge
skills.description: This skill makes Konan (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Demonic Statue Summoning
skills.description: Nagato (S) targets all enemies and deals 15 damage to them. Nagato will gain 10 permanent destructible defense. The following turn, 'Etheral Dragon' will deal an additional 10 damage to enemies affected by this skill.

skills.name: Etheral Dragon
skills.description: Using Etheral Dragon, Nagato deals 20 damage to one enemy. If that enemy's health drops to 30 or less, they will have their physical and mental skills stunned for 1 turn.

skills.name: Samsara of Heavenly Life
skills.description: Nagato (S) uses Samsara of Heavenly Life to heal all allies for 40 health. Any dead ally on Nagato's team will be revived back to 30 health and will become invulnerable for 1 turn. Nagato will lose 50% of his current health* for each ally revived by this skill.

skills.name: Bansho Block
skills.description: This skill makes Nagato (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Cerberus Hydra
skills.description: Animal Path Pein summons a giant multiple headed dog, dealing 20 damage to all enemies. For 2 turns, any enemy that uses a skill will be dealt 15 piercing damage.

skills.name: Drill Bird
skills.description: Animal Path Pein summons a giant drill-beaked bird, dealing 20 damage to one enemy and 20 damage to another random enemy for 2 turns. The following turn, 'Cerberus Hydra' will cost 1 ninjutsu and 1 random chakra instead.

skills.name: Invisible Chameleon
skills.description: Animal Path Pein summons his chameleon, protecting himself or an ally. For 4 turns, that ally will ignore stun effects and gains 50% damage reduction. This skill is invisible.

skills.name: Panda Defense
skills.description: This skill can be used on himself or an ally, making himself or that ally invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Animal Path Summoning
skills.description: Female Animal Path summons all pre-selected animals to the battlefield. For each animal summoned, Female Animal Path gains 5 destructible defense. Animals, when summoned, cannot be pre-selected for the following 3 turns. This skill will cost 1 additional random chakra for each pre-selected animal. This skill ignores invulnerability and cannot be countered or reflected.

skills.name: Rampaging Buffalo
skills.description: Pre-selects this animal for the next use of 'Animal Path Summoning'. When active, deals 10 damage to all enemies for 3 turns. During this time, any enemy that does not use a new skill will take another 10 damage. This skill will be replaced by 'Stampeding Rhino'.

skills.name: Venomous Centipede
skills.description: Pre-selects this animal for the next use of 'Animal Path Summoning'. When active, Female Animal Path grants her team 15 points of destructible defense and any enemy that destroys it will take 5 affliction damage* for 3 turns.

skills.name: Giant Crab
skills.description: Pre-selects this animal for the next use of 'Animal Path Summoning'. When active, Female Animal Path and her allies become invulnerable to non-affliction skills for 1 turn.

skills.name: Stampeding Rhino
skills.description: Pre-selects this animal for the next use of 'Animal Path Summoning'. For 3 turns, each turn a random enemy will take 20 damage and will have their non-mental skills stunned for 1 turn. This skill will be replaced by 'Rampaging Buffalo' after use.

skills.name: Chakra Burst
skills.description: Asura prevents one enemy from becoming invulnerable or reducing damage, then deals 20 damage for 1 turn. During this time, any enemy that uses a new skill on him will take 10 damage. This skill will be replaced permanently.

skills.name: Cluster Bombs
skills.description: Asura Path bombs all enemies, dealing 20 piercing damage to them. For 1 turn, any enemy that uses a new harmful physical or chakra skill will be dealt 10 piercing damage.

skills.name: Heat Seeker
skills.description: Asura Path uses Heat Seeker on one enemy. After 3 turns, that enemy will take 25 piercing damage. This skill is invisible until triggered. This skill stacks.

skills.name: Rinnegan Evasion
skills.description: This skill makes Asura Path Pein (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Crown Shockwave
skills.description: Asura Path deals 20 damage to all enemies. The following turn, they will be dealt 5 affliction damage. This skill becomes 'Chakra Burst' after being used.

skills.name: Mind Invasion
skills.description: Human Path deals 20 piercing damage to one enemy and stuns their harmful skills for 1 turn. The following turn, this skill becomes 'Soul Steal'.

skills.name: Brain Plunder
skills.description: Human Path steals 10 HP from one enemy, makes them unable to reduce damage or become invulnerable for 1 turn, and reveals their invisible skills for 3 turns. Next turn, if Human uses a new harmful skill, that enemy will have their helpful skills stunned for 1 turn.

skills.name: Sneak Attack
skills.description: Human Path Pein (S) launches a sneak attack dealing 25 piercing damage to one enemy. This skill ignores invulnerability.

skills.name: Rinnegan Awareness
skills.description: This skill makes Human Path Pein (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Soul Steal
skills.description: Human Path rips the soul of an enemy affected by 'Mind Invasion', stealing 20 HP from them and dealing 15 affliction damage. If that enemy's health drops to 5 or less health, they will be instantly killed. This skill ignores invulnerability.

skills.name: Energy Shield
skills.description: Preta Path (S) uses Energy Shield on one enemy removing 1 bloodline or Genjutsu chakra. That enemy will be dealt 25 piercing damage.

skills.name: Rinnegan Absorption
skills.description: Preta Path Pein (S) uses Rinnegan Absorption to protect himself. All damage dealt on Preta Path Pein (S) will be ignored and any enemy that uses a new damaging harmful skill on him will lose chakra equal the chakra cost of the skill used (except Random Chakra). This skill is invisible.

skills.name: Chakra Pin
skills.description: Using Chakra Pin Preta Path Pein (S) stuns one enemy's harmful skills. Preta Path Pein (S) will steal 1 bloodline or genjutsu chakra.

skills.name: Agile Dodge
skills.description: This skill makes Preta Path Pein (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Outer Path
skills.description: Naraka Path summons the Outer Path, dealing 10 affliction damage to all enemies for 3 turns. During this time, 'Judgement' can be used.

skills.name: Judgement
skills.description: Naraka executes an enemy affected by 'Outer Path', stealing 35 health from them. For 1 turn, that enemy will ignore healing effects.

skills.name: Rejuvenation
skills.description: Naraka Path uses Rejuvination on himself or an ally, healing them for 25 health and removing all affliction skills from them. This skill can be used on dead allies. If used on a dead ally, 'Rejuvination' will have its cost increased by 1 genjutsu chakra and heal increased by 15 permanently.

skills.name: Chakra Rod Deflection
skills.description: This skill makes Naraka Path Pein (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Chakra Rod
skills.description: Deva Path Pein (S) targets one enemy and uses Chakra Rod. When that enemy uses a new skill they will be dealt 15 piercing damage and Deva will steal 1 bloodline or ninjutsu chakra from them. This skill is invisible until triggered. This skill stacks.

skills.name: Violent Water Wave
skills.description: Deva Path Pein (S) uses Violent Water Wave on all enemies. For 1 turn all enemies chakra or ranged skills will cost 1 additional random chakra. Deva Path Pein (S) gains 50% damage reduction during this skill. This skill becomes 'Chibaku Tensei' for 2 turns.

skills.name: Universal Pull
skills.description: Deva Path Pein (S) uses Universal Pull on one enemy for 1 turn. If that enemy uses a new harmful physical or chakra skill they will be countered, will take 20 damage and will deal 10 less non-affliction damage for 1 turn. This skill is invisible and becomes 'Shinra Tensei' for 2 turns.

skills.name: Rinnegan Pressure
skills.description: This skill makes Deva Path Pein (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Shinra Tensei
skills.description: Deva Path Pein (S) uses 'Shinra Tensei' to deal 30 damage to all enemies. For 1 turn Deva Path Pein (S) will become invulnerable. This skill becomes 'Universal Pull' when used.

skills.name: Chibaku Tensei
skills.description: Using his ultimate jutsu Deva Path Pein (S) deals 30 damage to all enemies. For 1 turn damage dealt by the enemy team will be reduced by 5. This skill cannot be countered and becomes 'Violent Water Wave' when used.

skills.name: Spore Technique
skills.description: Zetsu plants spore clones into an ally, granting them 10 permanent destructible defense and making them ignore all harmful non-damage effects until this destructible defense is destroyed. When it's destroyed, that ally will gain 1 random chakra. This skill is invisible.

skills.name: Wood Release Roots
skills.description: Zetsu manipulates wood roots and attacks an enemy from below, dealing 30 piercing damage and stunning that enemy's physical and chakra skills for 1 turn. This skill ignores invulnerability.

skills.name: Parasite Clone Trap
skills.description: Zetsu targets one enemy, reducing their non-affliction damage by 10 permanently. If that enemy uses a new skill, that skill will be copied and 'Parasite Clone Trap' will end. This skill will be replaced by the copied skill for 1 turn. This skill is invisible.

skills.name: Zetsu Split
skills.description: This skill makes Zetsu (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: White Zetsu Host
skills.description: White Zetsu cannot become invulnerable permanently. Each turn he gains 3 clone stacks, and if stunned will gain 15 points of unpierceable damage reduction the following turn. At 3 clone stacks, he gains 15 points of damage reduction. At 6, he gains 15 destructible defense. At 9, he ignores affliction damage. Each skill he uses consumes 6 clone stacks.

skills.name: Clones Assault
skills.description: At 3/6/9 clones, this skill costs 1 additional random chakra and deals 25/45/65 piercing damage to one enemy. This skill cannot be countered.

skills.name: Mass Reproduction
skills.description: White Zetsu Clones will mass produce all over the battlefield for 4 turns, dealing 10 damage to one random enemy while one random ally will gain 10 points of damage reduction. During this time, this skill becomes 'Parasitic Grab'.

skills.name: White Assimilation: Poison Mist
skills.description: White Zetsu will target all enemies on the battlefield for 2 turns. All enemies will become invulnerable to friendly skills and take 5 additional damage from White Zetsu's skills.

skills.name: Parasitic Grab
skills.description: White Zetsu will make one enemy unable to target anyone else but White Zetsu for 1 turn. They will take 50% more damage from White Zetsu's skills for 2 turns.

skills.name: Kamui
skills.description: If used on an ally: That ally will become invulnerable for 1 turn. If used on an enemy: deals 20 piercing damage to them and Tobi becomes invulnerable to that enemy for 2 turns. If they are invulnerable, deals 10 additional damage. Ignores invulnerability.

skills.name: Kamui Snare
skills.description: Tobi deals 10 piercing damage to an enemy, making them invulnerable to helpful skills and nullifying the non-damage effects of their next harmful skill for 1 turn. During 'Tobi Sharingan', this skill will deal 15 piercing damage and will nullify non-damage effects for 2 turns.

skills.name: Tobi Sharingan
skills.description: For 4 turns, Tobi gains 10 points of unpierceable damage reduction. During this time, 'Kamui' deals 15 additional damage, and removes all harmful effects when used on an ally. This skill will be replaced. When used, 100% of Tobi's current health is stored.

skills.name: Uchiha Perception
skills.description: This skill makes Tobi (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Hidden Izanagi
skills.description: Tobi uses Hidden Izanagi. After 2 turns Tobi's health will return to the health value stored by 'Tobi Sharingan'. This skill is invisible and can only be used once. This skill will be activated even if Tobi is killed.

skills.name: Strange Jutsu
skills.description: Masked Man isolates himself and one enemy from the battlefield, *making them both invulnerable to every characters except each other for 3 turns; This effect cannot be ignored. During this time, that enemy will take 15 damage each turn.

skills.name: Chain Assault
skills.description: Producing chains from his wrists, Masked Man deals 20 damage to one enemy, reducing their non-affliction damage by 10 for 1 turn. This skill deals 30 damage if they are affected by 'Strange Jutsu'.

skills.name: Summoning: Kyuubi
skills.description: Masked Man may summon Kyuubi if he has 50 health or less, granting himself 40 permanent points of destructible defense. While he has this destructible defense, this skill will be replaced by 'Summoned Kyuubi: Bijuudama'.

skills.name: Masked Man Block
skills.description: This skill makes Masked Man invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Summoned Kyuubi: Bijuudama
skills.description: Kyuubi gathers a massive sphere of chakra and fires it at all enemies dealing 35 piercing damage to them.

skills.name: Paper Chakram
skills.description: Konan forms and fires a paper chakram towards an enemy, dealing 35 piercing damage to them. For 1 turn, Konan's skills will cost 1 less random chakra.

skills.name: Paper Ocean: Chasm Trap
skills.description: Konan traps all enemies in a chasm of the ocean made of a million papers. For 3 turns, all non-affliction damage will be reduced to a maximum of 25. During this time, this skill will be replaced and each time it successfully reduces an enemy's non-affliction damage, Konan will gain 1 random charka.

skills.name: Explosive Papers Barrage
skills.description: Konan rushes toward an enemy and ambushes them with multiple explosive papers, stunning their skills for 3 turns and dealing 15 damage to them each turn.

skills.name: The Bridge to the Peace
skills.description: This skill makes Konan of the Rain (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Paper Ocean: Explosive Papers Detonate
skills.description: Konan detonates all the millions of explosive papers, crushing all enemies trapped by 'Paper Ocean: Chasm Trap', and dealing 20 damage to them and stunning their skills for 2 turns.

skills.name: Rasengan Riot
skills.description: By forming multiple Rasengan over his head, Naruto deals 30 damage to one enemy. A random teammate of that enemy will also be dealt 20 damage. The following turn, this skill will be replaced by 'Planetary Rasengan'.

skills.name: Rasenkyugan
skills.description: Naruto grabs multiple enemies and smashes them into a giant Rasengan, dealing 15 piercing damage to all enemies for 1 turn. This skill will deal an additional 5 damage when it's used. The following turn, this skill will be replaced by 'Mini-Bijuudama'.

skills.name: Summoning: Mayhem
skills.description: Naruto summons Mayhem in the battlefield. For 1 turn, the first harmful skill used on Naruto will be countered. The countered enemy will receive 15 additional damage from 'Mini Rasenshuriken'. The following turn, this skill will be replaced by 'Mini-Rasenshuriken'. This skill is invisible.

skills.name: Supersonic Speed
skills.description: This skill makes Shinobi Alliance Naruto (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Planetary Rasengan
skills.description: Naruto forms a big Rasengan surrounded by other Rasengans, targeting one enemy and dealing 35 damage to them. If this skill kills that enemy, Naruto will deal 10 additional damage for 2 turns and will be unable to be killed during this time.

skills.name: Mini-Bijuudama
skills.description: By compressing chakra, Naruto creates a miniature of Bijuudama and deals 35 affliction damage to one enemy. For 1 turn, that enemy's skills will deal 10 less non-affliction damage and the cost of their skills will be increased by 1 random chakra.

skills.name: Mini-Rasenshuriken
skills.description: Naruto targets one enemy, destroying their destructible defense and dealing 15 piercing damage to them. This skill cannot be countered or reflected.

skills.name: Empowered Devasting Punch
skills.description: Amplifying her strength, Sakura deals 20 damage to one enemy and 5 damage to all others. While 'Strength of a Hundred Seal' is active, this skill will deal 35 damage to one enemy, and 10 to all others.

skills.name: Superior Healing
skills.description: With her superior healing skills, Sakura heals half of one ally's missing health, rounded down, and removes all enemy affliction effects from them. While 'Strength of a Hundred Seal' is active, this skill will cost 1 random and have no cooldown.

skills.name: Strength of a Hundred Seal
skills.description: Sakura gains 3 Seals. During this time, each time Sakura uses a skill other than her invulnerability, she will use up 1 Seal. While 'Strength of a Hundred Seal' is active, Sakura can use this skill again for no cost to restore 25 health and remove all harmful effects on her.

skills.name: Summoning: Katsuyu
skills.description: This skill makes Shinobi Alliance Sakura (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Tiger Vision Staring Bullet
skills.description: By using this sealing technique, Sai stuns one enemy's harmful skills permanently and deals 25 damage to them each turn. If that enemy uses a new skill, this skill will end and Sai gains 1 genjutsu chakra. This skill ends if Sai is killed.

skills.name: Great Beast Painting: Kamikaze Birds
skills.description: Sai makes one enemy receive 5 additional damage from non-affliction skills* and deals them 10 piercing damage to them each turn permanently. If that enemy uses a new skill, they will take 20 piercing damage and then this skill will end. This skil ends if Sai is killed.

skills.name: Great Beast Painting: Ink Warriors
skills.description: Sai grants one ally and himself 20 points of destructible defense. If that ally's destructible defense is destroyed, 'Great Beast Painting: Kamikaze Birds' will have no cost for 1 turn. If Sai destructible defense is destroyed, 'Tiger Vision Staring Bullet' will cost 1 random chakra for 1 turn.

skills.name: Sai Kunai Parry
skills.description: This skill makes Shinobi Alliance Sai (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Kubikiribouchou: Heavy Attack
skills.description: Using Zabuza's sword, Kakashi destroys one enemy's destructible defense and deals 15 piercing damage to them. Afterwards, Kakashi will also steal 5 health from that enemy. The following turn, 'Lightning-Infused Kunai' will cost 1 ninjutsu and 1 random chakra.

skills.name: Lightning-Infused Kunai
skills.description: Kakashi deals 40 piercing damage to one enemy, ignoring counters and reflects. If this skill successfully kills the target, it will have its cooldown reset, its chakra cost changed to 2 random chakra, and its damage increased by 10 for 1 turn.

skills.name: Lightning Transmission Cable
skills.description: For 3 turns, Kakashi gains 15 points of damage reduction and any enemy that uses a new non-mental skill on him will take 10 piercing damage. During this time, all enemies will be marked and, if they use a new harmful damaging skill, Kakashi's other skills will permanently steal 5 health from them, dealt as a new source of damage. This effect stacks.

skills.name: Earth Release: Earth-Style Wall
skills.description: This skill makes Shinobi Alliance Kakashi (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Continuous Shadow Sewing
skills.description: Shikamaru deals 30 piercing damage to one enemy and stuns their non-chakra skills for 1 turn. If that enemy doesn't use any new skill, they will take 15 additional piercing damage. During 'Tatical Range Increase', this skill will deal 15 additional damage.

skills.name: Tatical Range Increase
skills.description: For 1 turn, Shikamaru will ignore all damage dealt and will target all enemies. During this time, the enemies that use a new skill will be able to be target of 'Tatical Shadow Bind' for 1 turn. This skill becomes 'Tatical Shadow Bind' for 1 turn and is invisible.

skills.name: Ally Shadow Control
skills.description: Shikamaru target one ally for 3 turns, making their skills have 1 cooldown decreased, and if Shikamaru uses a new skill that ally will become invulnerable to damage skills for 1 turn.

skills.name: Hide and Thinking
skills.description: This skill makes Shinobi Alliance Shikamaru (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Tatical Shadow Bind
skills.description: Shikamaru deals 30 damage to all enemies affected by 'Tatical Range Increase', and for 2 turns stuns their physical and chakra skills.

skills.name: Butterfly Bullet Bombing
skills.description: Chouji slams his fist into an enemy's face, first ignoring all harmful effects other than chakra cost changes for 1 turn and then dealing 30 damage to one enemy. This skill cannot be countered or reflected and Chouji's skills will cost 2 additional random chakra afterwards.

skills.name: Human Bullet Tank
skills.description: Chouji rolls over one enemy for 2 turns, dealing 15 damage to them. During this time, Chouji will counter all new physical and chakra skills used on him.* This skill will increase the cost of Chouji's skills by 1 random chakra each turn.

skills.name: Butterfly Control
skills.description: Using his new found control, Chouji taps into even more power. This skill will be replaced by 'Super-Punch'. Each turn, the existing cost of Chouji's skills will be decreased by 1 random chakra.

skills.name: Butterfly Block
skills.description: This skill makes Shinobi Alliance Chouji (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Super-Punch
skills.description: Chouji punches an enemy down with a fistful of chakra, removing all Harmfull effects on him and then dealing 30 damage to one enemy, this skill cannot be countered or reflected and chouji skills cost 2 additional random chakras afterwards.

skills.name: Mind Body Switch Interference
skills.description: Ino interferes one enemy for 1 turn. The following turn, that enemy will receive 15 piercing damage and if that enemy uses a new harmful skill, they will be countered. If successful, this skill will be replaced by the countered skill, which will cost random chakra. This skill is invisible.

skills.name: Enhanced Proxy Surveillance
skills.description: For 4 turns all damage reduction and destructible defense effects all enemies use will be reduced by 15, percentage damage reduction will be reduced by 50% and Ino will know when and where any skill is used. This skill can't be countered, reflected and is invisible.

skills.name: Mind Clone Switch
skills.description: Ino enters the mind of both of her allies, making their bodies fight on regardless of their state. For 3 turns, both of Ino's allies will ignore all harmful effects other than damage and chakra cost changes. This skill is invisible and will end if Ino dies.

skills.name: Ino Dodge
skills.description: This skill makes Shinobi Alliance Ino (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Insect Assault
skills.description: Shino deals 10 affliction damage to one enemy for 3 turns. During 'Bug Barrier', this skill can be used on Shino, or an ally, to heal 10 health for 3 turns.

skills.name: Insect Coffin
skills.description: Shino surrounds one enemy with insects, dealing 15 affliction damage to them for 3 turns. During this time, that enemy will be unable to reduce damage or become invulnerable* and if Shino or an ally uses a new damaging skill, or new action, on that enemy, they will heal 15 health*.

skills.name: Bug Barrier
skills.description: Shino creates a massive barrier of bugs to defend his team. For 1 turn, Shino and his allies will heal 15 health and will gain 15 points of destructible defense. Afterwards, they will heal 5 health permanently in the following turns. This skill ends if Shino dies, and it will be re-applied if used while active.

skills.name: Hidden Insects
skills.description: This skill makes Shinobi Alliance Shino (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Sixty-Four Palms
skills.description: Hinata delivers a series of attacks to one enemy, dealing 25 piercing damage to them and stunning their chakra skills for 1 turn. While improved, this skill will stun non-mental skills for 1 turn instead.

skills.name: Gentle Step Twin Lion Fists
skills.description: Hinata assaults one enemy with her twin lion fists, dealing 30 piercing and removing 1 taijutsu or ninjutsu chakra from them. The following 2 turns, this skill will be replaced by 'Chakra Lion Attack'. While improved, this skill will deal 35 piercing damage and remove 1 random chakra instead.

skills.name: Byakugan: Enhanced Vision
skills.description: For 4 turns, Hinata's non-damage effects cannot be ignored and her skills will be improved. During this time, Hinata will use her Byakugan to reveal any invisible skill used by the enemy team.

skills.name: Byakugan: Focus
skills.description: This skill makes Shinobi Alliance Hinata (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Chakra Lion Attack
skills.description: This skill deals 25 piercing damage to one enemy and removes 1 taijutsu or ninjutsu chakra. While improved, this skill will remove 1 random chakra instead.

skills.name: Tornado Fang
skills.description: Kiba deals 30 piercing damage to one enemy and makes them deal 10 less non-affliction damage for 1 turn. During 'Three Headed Wolf', this skill will deal 10 additional damage.

skills.name: Three Headed Wolf
skills.description: Kiba removes all harmful physical and chakra skills from his team and, for 3 turns, targets all enemies. During this time, enemies that use a new harmful skill will take 5 piercing damage and permanently receive 5 additional damage from physical melee skills. This skill is replaced by 'Tail Rotating Fang'.

skills.name: Man Animal Tatics
skills.description: Kiba and one ally will deal 5 additional damage with non-affliction skills for 2 turns. During this time, every time a new enemy harmful skill is used on them, their skills will cost 1 less random chakra for 1 turn.

skills.name: Kiba Block
skills.description: This skill makes Shinobi War Kiba (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Tail Rotating Fang
skills.description: Kiba deals 45 piercing damage to one enemy and becomes invulnerable to physical skills. Permanently, both Kiba and that enemy will deal 5 less physical damage.

skills.name: Bashousen: Coil of Fire
skills.description: Using the Sage of the Six Paths' legendary leaf fan, Tenten blasts her enemies with a sea of raging fire, dealing 15 damage and 15 affliction damage* to them. The following 3 turns, they will take 5 affliction damage.

skills.name: Bashousen: Coil of Wind
skills.description: Using the Bashousen to throw a gust of wind, the following turn all non-mental skills used on Tenten or her team will be reflected back to the enemy. This skill is invisible.

skills.name: Bashousen: Strike
skills.description: If used on an enemy, deals 15 affliction damage. If used on herself, or an ally, grants 15 points of destructible defense. If used after 'Bashousen: Coil of Fire', this will also deal 5 affliction damage permanently. If used after 'Bashousen: Coil of Wind', this will also reflect non-mental skills for 1 turn; Invisible.

skills.name: Reflective Paper Bombs
skills.description: This skill makes Shinobi Alliance Tenten (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Konoha Rising Wind
skills.description: Lee tries to hinder an enemy, dealing 15 damage to them and lowering all their non-affliction damage by 15 for 2 turns. This skill will deal an additional 10 damage, and the damage reduction effect will last 1 additional turn for each ally that is dead.

skills.name: Konoha Great Whirlwind
skills.description: Lee gains momentum, dealing 25 damage to one enemy and gaining 10 points of damage reduction for 1 turn. The following turn this skill will deal an additional 10 damage and grant 10 more damage reduction. This skill will deal an additional 10 damage for every ally that has been killed.

skills.name: One-Man Front Lotus
skills.description: Using a modified version of Front Lotus, Lee dives down on an opponent, dealing 20 damage to them. This skill will deal an additional 20 damage for each ally that is dead, and an additional 20 damage for each 30 health that Lee has lost.

skills.name: Lee Heavy Block
skills.description: This skill makes Rock Lee (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Sand Binding Prison
skills.description: Gaara deals 30 piercing damage to one enemy and stuns their non-mental skills for 1 turn. During 'Desert Layered Imperial Funeral Seal', this skill will deal 10 additional damage. During 'Mother's Absolute Defense', this skill's stunning effect will last 1 additional turn.

skills.name: Desert Layered Imperial Funeral Seal
skills.description: Gaara deals 15 piercing damage to all enemies. For 2 turns, any enemy that uses a new harmful skill will be dealt 5 piercing damage. This skill ends if 'Mother's Absolute Defense' is used.

skills.name: Mother's Absolute Defense
skills.description: Gaara grants his team 15 permanent destructible defense. For 2 turns, if Gaara or an ally is targeted by a new harmful skill, they will gain 5 permanent destructible defense. This skill ends if 'Desert Layered Imperial Funeral Seal' is used.

skills.name: Sand Wall
