skills.name: Sakon: Chakra Unseal
skills.description: This skill makes Sakon invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Demonic Melody
skills.description: Tayuya deals 5 affliction damage to all enemies for 3 turns. During this time, if they use a new harmful damaging skill, Tayuya will steal 5 health from them. The following 3 turns, 'Doki Ghost' will be improved.

skills.name: Doki Ghost
skills.description: Tayuya summons her doki ghosts, dealing 20 affliction damage to one enemy. While improved, this skill will steal 20 health and 1 ninjutsu or bloodline chakra instead.

skills.name: Summoning: Doki Demons
skills.description: For 1 turn, the first harmful damaging skill used on her or an ally will be countered. If successful, the countered enemy will be dealt 5 damage and will have their harmful skills stunned for 1 turn. This skill is invisible.

skills.name: Tayuya: Chakra Unseal
skills.description: This skill makes Edo Tensei Tayuya (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Bone Rush
skills.description: Kimimaro rushes one enemy, dealing 25 damage to them and gaining 1 stack of 'Bone Spikes'. This skill will deal 10 additional damage for every 3 stacks of 'Bone Spikes'.

skills.name: Skeleton Splinters
skills.description: Kimimaro unleashes sharpened bone shards at all enemies, dealing 15 piercing damage to them and gaining 1 stack of 'Bone Spikes'. This skill will deal 5 additional damage for every 3 stacks of 'Bone Spikes'.

skills.name: Dead Man's Skewer
skills.description: Kimimaro impales his opponents, dealing 50 piercing damage to one enemy and 15 piercing damage to all other enemies. This skill cannot be countered and requires at least 5 stacks of 'Bone Spikes' to be used.

skills.name: Shikotsumyaku Guard
skills.description: Kimimaro reinforces his body with his Shikotsumyaku, gaining 20 permanent destructible defense. For the next 2 turns, whenever an enemy uses a new non-mental skill on Kimimaro, he will gain 1 stack of 'Bone Spikes'.

skills.name: Bone Spikes
skills.description: Kimimaro forms sharp bone spikes around his body. Whenever an enemy uses a new non-mental skill on him, they will take 3 piercing damage*. This skill stacks and cannot be removed.

skills.name: Snake Coil
skills.description: Kabuto uses his snake to coil around an enemy's body, dealing 10 affliction damage to them permanently. During this time, if that enemy uses a new harmful skill, Kabuto will heal 10 health. This skill stacks but will end if used on a different enemy or if Kabuto is killed.

skills.name: Edo Tensei Technique
skills.description: Kabuto deals 25 affliction damage to one enemy and stuns their harmful skills for 1 turn. If that enemy is killed in this turn, they will become an Edo Tensei and will replace one of Kabuto's allies if they die or if they are currently dead, returning them to 35 health. This effect triggers once per game.

skills.name: Edo Tensei Summoning: Akatsuki
skills.description: Kabuto gains 50 points of destructible defense and replaces his skills with their alternate versions until it is destroyed. Using this skill will end 'Snake Coil'.

skills.name: White Snake Awakening
skills.description: This skill makes White Snake Kabuto (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Edo Tensei: Clay Clone
skills.description: Kabuto targets one enemy for 1 turn. If that enemy uses a new harmful skill, they will be countered and will be dealt 20 piercing damage. This skill is invisible.

skills.name: Edo Tensei: Totsuka Blade
skills.description: Kabuto deals 20 piercing damage to one enemy and removes 1 bloodline or genjutsu from them.

skills.name: Edo Tensei: Flame Mask
skills.description: Kabuto deals 20 affliction damage to one enemy and stuns their helpful skills for 1 turn.

skills.name: Edo Tensei: Human Path
skills.description: Kabuto steals 20 health from one enemy and stuns their harmful skills for 1 turn.

skills.name: Majestic Sting
skills.description: Fuu deals 15 damage to one enemy. The following turn, that enemy will receive 10 additional damage from Fuu's skills.

skills.name: Nanabi: Flying Assault
skills.description: Fuu becomes invulnerable for 1 turn and deals 30 damage to one enemy ignoring invulnerability.

skills.name: Scale Powder Blinding Attack
skills.description: Fuu deals 10 piercing damage to one enemy and makes them unable to reduce damage or become invulnerable for 1 turn. The following turn, that enemy will take another 10 damage and will be stunned for 1 turn.

skills.name: Fuu: Rinnegan Awareness
skills.description: This skill may be used to cast the last skill used by Fuu, costing random chakra and dealing 5 additional damage. Afterwards, the original version of the casted skill will be unable to be used by Fuu for 1 turn.

skills.name: Cat Claws
skills.description: Yugito deals 15 damage to one enemy and stuns their non-mental skills for 1 turn.

skills.name: Fiery Mouse Hairball
skills.description: Yugito deals 15 damage to one enemy and removes 1 taijutsu chakra from them.

skills.name: Nibi: Rage Punch
skills.description: Yugito destroys all destructible defense of one enemy, deals 15 piercing damage to them and kills them if their health drops to 10 or less.

skills.name: Yugito: Rinnegan Awareness
skills.description: This skill makes Edo Tensei Yugito (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Passive: Nibi Awakening
skills.description: Every time Yugito uses a new harmful skill, she gains 10 additional damage, stacking until she stops using new harmful skills. If Yugito passes 2 turns without using a new harmful skill, her skills will cost 1 random chakra for 1 turn. The bonus damage may only stack up to a maximum of 30.

skills.name: Water Mirror
skills.description: Yagura targets an enemy for 3 turns. If that enemy uses a new harmful skill, that skill will be permanently stored by 'Water Mirror' and they will deal 5 less non-affliction damage for 1 turn. This skill is invisible, ignores invulnerability, and cannot be used on the same target.

skills.name: Hook Staff Tilt
skills.description: Yagura casts a random skill stored by 'Water Mirror' on an enemy. The stored skill is removed. This skill may only be used if 'Water Mirror' has at least one skill stored.

skills.name: Mirror Image
skills.description: Yagura uses Mirror Image on an enemy, dealing 30 damage to them. For 1 turn, they will deal 5 less non-affliction damage and a random harmful skill from that enemy will be stored by 'Water Mirror'. The following turn, 'Hook Staff Tilt' will cast 2 random skills stored by 'Water Mirror' at once.

skills.name: Yagura Partial Tailed Beast Mode
skills.description: This skill makes Edo Tensei Yagura (S) invulnerable for 1 turn. The following turn, 'Hook Staff Tilt' will be improved and cost 1 random chakra instead.

skills.name: Reflective Mirror
skills.description: This skill will be activated every time Yagura uses 'Hook Staff Tilt' or 'Mirror Image'. For 1 turn, Yagura will ignore the first harmful physical or chakra skill used on him. If successfully triggered, the ignored skill will be stored by 'Water Mirror'. This skill will be disabled for 2 turns when activated.

skills.name: Multiple Scorching Rocks
skills.description: Roshi deals 30 affliction damage to one enemy and 10 affliction damage to a random different enemy. 'Passive: Fiery Body' deals 1 additional damage permanently (stacks).

skills.name: Lava Armor
skills.description: Roshi gains 15 unpierceable defense and deals 10 affliction damage to any enemy that uses a new non-mental skill on him for 4 turns. 'Passive: Fiery Body' deals 1 additional damage permanently (stacks).

skills.name: Magma Field
skills.description: For 3 turns, Roshi will automatically trigger 'Passive: Fiery Body' at the end of every turn. The following 3 turns, the enemy team will remove/steal 1 less chakra with their skills. During this time, 'Multiple Scorching Rocks' will cost 1 less random energy. 'Passive: Fiery Body' deals 1 additional damage permanently (stacks).

skills.name: Roshi Partial-Tailed Beast Defense
skills.description: This skill makes Roshi invulnerable for 1 turn. 'Passive: Fiery Body' deals 1 additional damage permanently (stacks).

skills.name: Passive: Fiery Body
skills.description: Every time Roshi uses a new skill, he deals 1 affliction damage to the enemy team, ignoring invulnerability.

skills.name: Red-Hot Habanero
skills.description: Kushina uses her strength to protect an ally. The following 3 turns, if Kushina uses 'Fierce Punch' or 'Dropping Kick', the protected ally will heal 15 health. During this time, she will ignore stun effects.

skills.name: Fierce Punch
skills.description: Kushina lands a fierce punch on an enemy, dealing 20 damage to them. The following turn, 'Dropping Kick' will deal 20 additional damage.

skills.name: Dropping Kick
skills.description: Kushina drops down with a powerful kick, dealing 10 damage to one enemy and stunning their skills for 1 turn. The following turn, 'Fierce Punch' will deal 10 additional damage and will stun an enemy for 1 turn.

skills.name: Skilled Landing
skills.description: This skill makes Young Kushina invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Missiles Assault
skills.description: For 3 turns, Mecha Naruto will deal 10 piercing damage to all enemies, and if they use a new skill, they will receive 5 piercing damage. During this time, this skill will be replaced by 'Pinpoint'.

skills.name: Multiple-Bladed Vehicle
skills.description: Mecha Naruto attacks all enemies for 3 turns, dealing 10 piercing damage to them each turn that they do not use a new skill. During this time, this skill will be replaced by 'Drill Run'.

skills.name: Nine Tails Chakra Bomb
skills.description: Mecha Naruto uses all the power of the Kyuubi stored inside him, instantly killing one enemy at 65 or less health. Afterwards, Mecha Naruto will die. This skill cannot be countered or reflected and ignores invulnerability. This skill's self-kill cannot be ignored.

skills.name: Awakening: Kyuubi Mode
skills.description: Mecha Naruto will ignore all non-damage effects and deal 20 additional damage with his skills permanently. This skill can only be used once and only when Mecha Naruto has 40 or less health.

skills.name: Pinpoint
skills.description: Mecha Naruto stuns one enemy for 1 turn. During this time, that enemy will receive 10 additional damage from harmful skills and will be unable to reduce damage or become invulnerable.

skills.name: Drill Run
skills.description: Mecha Naruto pierces one enemy, destroying their destructible defense, dealing 30 piercing damage to them, and stunning them for 1 turn.

skills.name: Sasuke Sharingan
skills.description: Sasuke targets one enemy, making them ignore helpful effects for 3 turns. During this time, they will receive 10 additional damage from Sasuke's skills .

skills.name: Fire Style: Fireball Jutsu
skills.description: Sasuke launches a giant fireball at one enemy, dealing 20 affliction damage to them and stunning their non-mental skills for 1 turn. The following turn, they will receive 10 additional damage from 'Chidori!'.

skills.name: Chidori!
skills.description: Using a lightning element attack jutsu, Sasuke deals 35 piercing damage to one enemy.

skills.name: Sasuke Hide
skills.description: This skill makes Uchiha Sasuke invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Wood Release: Wood Dragon!
skills.description: For 2 turns, Hashirama will become invulnerable to all chakra skills* and for 2 turns, Hashirama will steal 1 random chakra from one enemy. The following 2 turns, this skill can be used again for 1 random chakra to steal all helpful skills from one enemy.

skills.name: Wood Release: Wood Human!
skills.description: For 2 turns, Hashirama will become invulnerable to all physical skills* and for 2 turns, Hashirama will deal 20 damage to one enemy. The following 2 turns, this skill can be used again for 1 random chakra to deal 20 damage to one enemy.

skills.name: Wood Release: True Thousand Hands!
skills.description: Hashirama summons a giant buddha that grants 35 destructible defense to Hashirama and his allies and for 3 turns, if used, 'Wood Release: Wood Dragon!' and 'Wood Release: Wood Human!' will initially last 1 additional turn and cost 1 less random chakra.

skills.name: Sage Knowledge!
skills.description: This skill makes Senju Hashirama invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Demon Shroud!
skills.description: For 1 turn, all enemies will have the cost of their harmful skills increased by 1 random chakra. Permanently, they will receive 5 additional damage from Zabuza's skills. Every turn, they will gain a random chakra token from 'Demon Shroud!'; This effect does not stack.

skills.name: Executioner Strike!
skills.description: Zabuza executes one enemy, dealing 25 piercing damage to them. If that enemy has a chakra token from 'Demon Shroud!', Zabuza will consume it, gaining that chakra token.

skills.name: Executioner Blade Absorption!
skills.description: Zabuza steals 10 health from one enemy. If that enemy has a chakra token from 'Demon Shroud!', their skills will also cost 1 additional chakra matching that token for 1 turn.

skills.name: Demon Insight!
skills.description: This skill makes Edo Tensei Zabuza (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: White Fang Slash!
skills.description: Using his kunai, Anbu Kakashi deals 20 piercing damage to one enemy. For 1 turn, that enemy will deal 5 less non-affliction damage. The following turn, Anbu Kakashi's skills will deal 10 additional damage.

skills.name: Amateur Raikiri!
skills.description: Using a weaker form of his signature jutsu, Anbu Kakashi deals 25 piercing damage to one enemy. For 1 turn, that enemy will deal 5 less non-affliction damage. The following turn, Anbu Kakashi's skills will deal 10 additional damage.

skills.name: Implanted Sharingan!
skills.description: For 2 turns, if one enemy uses a new skill, all non-damage effects from that skill will be copied. If successful, the next use of 'White Fang Slash!' or 'Amateur Raikiri!' will deal 15 additional damage and apply all copied effects. This skill ends when triggered.

skills.name: Quick Reflexes
skills.description: This skill makes Anbu Kakashi invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Chakra Enhanced Punch_skill_id_abkbp
skills.description: Enhancing her attack with finely controlled chakra, Sakura destroys the destructible defense of one enemy and deals 25 piercing damage to them.

skills.name: Trained Healing_skill_id_abkbp
skills.description: Using her trained healing skills, Sakura heals herself or an ally for 25 health and removes all harmful damage skills from them.

skills.name: Blossom's Fury_skill_id_abkbp
skills.description: Sakura releases a ground breaking punch, dealing 25 piercing damage to all enemies. This skill will deal 10 additional damage for each use of 'Chakra Enhanced Punch' or 'Trained Healing', removing all stacks afterwards.

skills.name: Insightful Dodge_skill_id_abkbp
skills.description: This skill makes Haruno Sakura (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.
